title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en Evaluation de la vulnérabilité d’un réseau d’accès Télécom de type PON (Passive Optical Network) vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS (Distributed Acoustic Sensor) - CDD de 12 mois
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 5 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en évaluation de la vulnérabilité d’un réseau d’accès Télécom de type PON (Passive Optical Network) vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS (Distributed Acoustic Sensor) pour rejoindre le département Communications et Electronique (COMELEC). Cette étude se situe dans le cadre du projet « Ecoute Acoustique Terrestre » (EAT) RAPID (Régime d’Appui Pour l’Innovation Duale), fruit d’un partenariat entre la société Febus Optics et Télécom Paris. La mesure de vibrations acoustiques distribuées par fibre optique (DAS, Distributed Acoustic Sensing) est une technologie récente, dont les applications ne cessent de se diversifier. On peut citer par exemple la détection d’intrusion en surveillance périmétrique, les mesures sismiques, le diagnostic de puits (pétrole, géothermie), etc. La bande passante de la mesure, de sub-Hertz à la centaine de kiloHertz, permet également d’envisager la captation de la bande audio, et donc de réaliser des mesures audios sur une fibre optique. Il est ainsi possible d’utiliser le réseau optique télécom d’un bâtiment pour réaliser des écoutes, en utilisant un système DAS modifié, intégrant des artéfacts matériels particuliers (enroulement, antennes, connecteurs) au voisinage de la zone d’écoute et un traitement du signal spécifique pour obtenir des performances suffisantes. Le cadre de ce Postdoc est d’évaluer la vulnérabilité d’un réseau télécom vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS. Le branchement sur un réseau optique Telecom local en fonctionnement nécessite de s’adapter à son architecture, notamment en termes de plan de longueur d’onde. L’audit des systèmes de télécommunication afin d’en évaluer la vulnérabilité constitue un enjeu majeur du réseau télécom. Un exemple de configuration d’un réseau d’accès est décrit dans la figure ci-après. Depuis le réseau Backbone, à partir du ‘Central Office’, les signaux télécoms sont acheminés chez les abonnés via le PON (Passive Optical Network). À l’intérieur des bâtiments, un réseau FTTX (Fiber To The X=H home, X=R room, X=O office, etc) ou un réseau local LAN (Local Area Network) optique servent respectivement à acheminer le signal optique jusqu’au terminal final ou à communiquer entre deux terminaux locaux via une liaison optique. Le PON comprend une fibre nourricière (Feeder Fiber) puis, au moins, un coupleur 1×N. Le codage de l’information est alors un mélange de multiplexage en longueur d’onde grossier (C-WDM) et de multiplexage temporel (TDM). Chaque voie de sortie du coupleur 1×N est envoyée vers des groupes de 1 à n abonnés à travers, au moins, un filtre qui sélectionne la longueur d’onde qui leur est allouée. Le signal après ce filtre est alors monochromatique et codé TDM. Le dernier coupleur 1×n répartie le signal chez les n abonnés. Ce PON comprend donc, entre autres, des coupleurs passifs qui divisent les signaux vers différents abonnés mais aussi des connecteurs, soudures, etc. L’objectif de ce Postdoc est de faire un état des lieux des différents types de réseau mis en place et d’en évaluer les conséquences sur la capacité de mesures DAS : · Description des différents types de réseaux locaux existants, · Etats des lieux des différents types de transmission : CWDM, TDM, … · Quels sont les différents points d’accès pour une mesure DAS ? · Comment discriminer les différentes fibres interrogées après un coupleur ? Influence des points réflecteurs, · Etude des différentes marges de puissance pour une mesure DAS, · Potentielle présence de nœuds d’insertion et limite de la transparence optique, · Sensibilité des mesures DAS en fonction des différents types de fibre et de leur environnement, · Influence du réflecteur final sur la capacité d’écoute. Le caractère innovant sera la définition des conditions du réseau et des configurations et des performances DAS permettant un audit cyber sur des infrastructures déjà déployées. Au-delà d’une synthèse des configurations que l’on peut trouver sur le terrain, il s’agira de mener des tests, soit sur un réseau réel auxquels un accès nous sera donné, soit sur un réseau modèle implémenté pour l’étude. Ces travaux permettront d’identifier le type de modules d’interfaçage nécessaires, et de les spécifier, puis de les concevoir et de les fabriquer. Vos principales missions seront : Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine des capteurs à fibre optique distribués Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat en génie électrique, en communications optiques, en photonique, en capteurs optiques ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez d’une solide expertise théorique et pratique en photonique et en traitement du signal numérique, ainsi que de bonnes compétences en programmation. Une connaissance des algorithmes de traitement du signal appliqués aux systèmes de communication ou aux capteurs à fibre optique, notamment dans le cadre de la détection cohérente, constitue un atout. Vous maîtrisez l’anglais, et la pratique du français est souhaitée. Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche appliquée et êtes capable d’évoluer dans un environnement multiculturel. Vous êtes à l’aise pour encadrer des stagiaires ou des étudiants dans le cadre de projets. Enfin, vous faites preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe, de qualités relationnelles, rédactionnelles et pédagogiques, ainsi que d’une excellente capacité d’analyse et de synthèse. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers, navette mutualisée en partance de la Porte d'Orléans). Vous bénéficierez de : 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT) flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service) télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75% Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne... A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé Informations diverses : Date limite de candidature : 30 novembre 2026 Type d'emploi : CDD de 12 mois Description de poste ici Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuel et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. title: Post-doctorante ou post-doctorant "Etude de capteurs sélectifs à des agents toxiques gazeux" - CDD 12 Mois
description: Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain . Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École. Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques. Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret. Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité. Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire mieux, avec moins. L’objectif ? Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité. 🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’ industrie du futur. Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ? 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous En tant que post-doctorant, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche et innovation affecté au Centre SPIN. Le centre « Sciences des Processus Industriels et Naturels » (SPIN) est un centre de recherche, d’enseignement et de transfert technologique reconnu pour son expertise en Génie des Procédés appliqué aux solides divisés. Il est au service de l’innovation pour les entreprises industrielles confrontées à la transition numérique et environnementale. La personne recrutée sera intégrée dans le département « Procédés de Transformation des Solides et Instrumentation » (PTSI) et dans le Laboratoire Georges Friedel UMR CNRS 5307. Le projet proposé ici consistera à développer de capteurs de gaz à partir de matériaux fonctionnels. L’étude des interactions solide/gaz sera menée en parallèle des caractérisations électriques sous atmosphère gazeuse complexe (bancs de test avec génération contrôlée de polluants). Cette étude sera menée en collaboration avec des chercheurs de IMT Mines Albi qui ont en charge la synthèse des matériaux sensibles et de IMT Atlantique pour l’intégration ultérieure du capteur dans des vêtements. Dans le cadre du développement de capteurs, les matériaux sensibles seront déposés sur des supports préalablement équipés d’électrodes. Cette phase devra être optimisée afin de pouvoir effectuer des caractérisations reproductibles. La stabilité, la sensibilité à différents gaz et la sélectivité à un gaz donné seront étudiées. Pour cela, des tests sous gaz cibles seront réalisés et analysés, en atmosphère simple dans un premier temps jusqu’à des tests sous atmosphères plus représentatives d’un environnement réel. raw.title: Post-doctorante ou post-doctorant "Etude de capteurs sélectifs à des agents toxiques gazeux" - CDD 12 Mois
raw.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

 L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

 

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche  articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité.

Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire mieux, avec moins.

L’objectif ? Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité.

🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’industrie du futur. 

Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ?

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que post-doctorant, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche et innovation affecté au Centre SPIN.

Le centre « Sciences des Processus Industriels et Naturels » (SPIN) est un centre de recherche, d’enseignement et de transfert technologique reconnu pour son expertise en Génie des Procédés appliqué aux solides divisés. Il est au service de l’innovation pour les entreprises industrielles confrontées à la transition numérique et environnementale. La personne recrutée sera intégrée dans le département « Procédés de Transformation des Solides et Instrumentation » (PTSI) et dans le Laboratoire Georges Friedel UMR CNRS 5307.

Le projet proposé ici consistera à développer de capteurs de gaz à partir de matériaux fonctionnels. L’étude des interactions solide/gaz sera menée en parallèle des caractérisations électriques sous atmosphère gazeuse complexe (bancs de test avec génération contrôlée de polluants).

Cette étude sera menée en collaboration avec des chercheurs de IMT Mines Albi qui ont en charge la synthèse des matériaux sensibles et de IMT Atlantique pour l’intégration ultérieure du capteur dans des vêtements.

Dans le cadre du développement de capteurs, les matériaux sensibles seront déposés sur des supports préalablement équipés d’électrodes. Cette phase devra être optimisée afin de pouvoir effectuer des caractérisations reproductibles. La stabilité, la sensibilité à différents gaz et la sélectivité à un gaz donné seront étudiées. Pour cela, des tests sous gaz cibles seront réalisés et analysés, en atmosphère simple dans un premier temps jusqu’à des tests sous atmosphères plus représentatives d’un environnement réel. Ensuite, des études d’adsorption seront réalisées, un équipement de chimisorption sera utilisé afin d’étudier l’interaction solide (matériau sensible) / gaz et permettra d’apporter une compréhension sur les mécanismes de détection, de capture ou de traitement.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’une thèse dans les domaines sciences pour l’ingénieur/chimie/matériaux et idéalement avec une expérience en mise en forme de matériaux organiques ou céramiques par voir humide ou en mesure de propriétés électrique ou électrochimique ou en caractérisation de capteurs de gaz.

·         Titulaire d’un doctorat en Sciences pour l’ingénieur, Chimie ou Matériaux

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

· Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

· Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

· Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail.

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.

Dans le cadre du projet « Réception de signaux GNSS sur antenne multicapteurs et réjection de brouilleurs » , qui vise à améliorer la robustesse des systèmes de réception GNSS (GPS, Galileo) face aux menaces de brouillage et de leurrage pour les besoins d'ArianeGroup, nous recrutons une post-doctorante ou un post-doctorant au sein de notre département Mathematical and Electrical Engineering (MEE) . title: Produktmanager Snack (m/w/d)
description: Gestalten Sie unser Snack-Sortiment von morgen! Bäcker Görtz steht mit rund 260 Filialen für handwerkliche Backkultur und frische Snacks – jeden Tag, für tausende Kundinnen und Kunden in der Region. Unser Snack-Geschäft wächst – und Sie sollen es künftig aktiv mitgestalten und weiterentwickeln. Ihre Mission: Sie machen unser Snack-Sortiment zur ersten Wahl in der Region: kreativ, marktorientiert und wirtschaftlich erfolgreich. Ihre Vorteile Eine Schlüsselposition mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum. Kurze Entscheidungswege und einen direkten Draht zur Geschäfts- und Verkaufsleitung. Eine attraktive Vergütung sowie einen Dienstwagen. Personalrabatt auf unser gesamtes Sortiment. Ein motiviertes Team, das Snacks genauso liebt wie Sie. Einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz in einem wachsenden regionalen Familienunternehmen. Ihre Aufgaben Sortimentsverantwortung: Sie entwickeln unser Snack-Sortiment strategisch weiter – von belegten Brötchen über warme Snacks bis hin zu saisonalen Aktionen. Produktentwicklung: Sie kreieren neue Snack-Produkte von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung in unseren Filialen und optimieren kontinuierlich bestehende Artikel. Präsentation: Sie stellen Ihre Produktkonzepte überzeugend in unseren Entscheidungsrunden vor – inklusive Verkostung, Kalkulation und fundierter Marktargumentation. Schnittstellenarbeit: Sie arbeiten eng mit unserem Marketing (Produktmanagement, Werbung), dem Einkauf (Rohstoffe, Konditionen) sowie unserem Backhaus (Produktion, Umsetzbarkeit) zusammen. Training vor Ort: Sie schulen und trainieren unsere Filialteams direkt am Point of Sale, damit jeder Snack in höchster Qualität bei unseren Kundinnen und Kunden ankommt. Führung: Sie führen und entwickeln ein Team von zwei Snack-Beauftragten. Ihr Profil Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Lebensmittelbereich (z. B. Bäcker/in, Konditor/in, Koch/Köchin, Fachkraft für Systemgastronomie) oder ein Studium der Lebensmitteltechnologie bzw. Ökotrophologie. Auch Quereinsteigerinnen und Quereinsteiger mit großer Leidenschaft für Lebensmittel und aktuelle Food-Trends sind willkommen. Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Produktentwicklung oder im Sortimentsmanagement, idealerweise in der Bäckerei-, Snack- oder Foodservice-Branche, ist von Vorteil, aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung. Ein gutes Gespür für Food-Trends und die Bedürfnisse unserer Kundinnen und Kunden. Ein sicheres Auftreten in Präsentationen sowie Freude daran, Menschen zu begeistern und Wissen zu vermitteln. Erste Führungserfahrung ist wünschenswert. Eine Hands-on-Mentalität, betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis sowie Reisebereitschaft innerhalb unseres Filialnetzes (Führerschein Klasse B). title: Senior Merchant Success Manager
description:
As a member of the ShipBob Team, you will... 

  • Grow with an Ownership Mindset: We champion continuous learning and innovation. You'll take on real problems, create tangible solutions, and drive results that move the needle for ShipBob, our merchants, and for your own professional growth. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career, this is the place. 
  • Collaborate with Peers and Leaders Alike: At ShipBob, leaders are accessible; feedback flows in both directions, and everyone, regardless of their seniority or role, steps up to help when needed. We hold each other to high standards because we trust each other to meet them. That combination of transparency and mutual respect is what makes the work here feel worth doing. 
  • Experience a High-Performance Culture and Clear Purpose: We are results-driven and clear about what that means: our goals are specific, accountability is shared, and every team member can see how their work connects to our mission. When we hit milestones, we celebrate them together. When we fall short, we learn and move forward. 

Hiring timeline: We are actively accepting applications and conducting interviews for this position. The anticipated start date for the selected candidate is February 2027.

Location: Remote in United Kingdom 

Role Description: 

The Senior Merchant Success Managers (Sr MSM) have a mission to provide a world-class experience to grow and retain ShipBob’s enterprise and strategic merchants. They are constantly working to identify and understand their merchants’ unique needs and deliver exceptional value. A Sr. MSM aligns with ShipBob’s more complex middle-market merchants who are expanding into new markets, diversifying their fulfillment, and scaling rapidly. The Sr. MSM will need to be comfortable managing strategic business reviews, communicating both business and industry insights, and driving tactical account planning. Success for a Sr. MSM is building a positive team culture, being a merchant advocate, and aligning strategic relationships at the executive level to establish a trusted partnership and lasting results. This role reports to the Senior Manager of Merchant Success. 

What you’ll do:  

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders and team leads to continuously improve the merchant experience.  
  • Increase the average performance and KPIs of your customers’ to ensure a world-class customer experience.  
  • Coach team members to enhance performance to middle market, complex merchants. 
  • Analyze your merchants’ supply chain performance and identify opportunities or risks to help advise proactive countermeasures.  
  • Conduct business reviews and track merchant growth within ShipBob and identify areas for further expansion.  
  • Grow and maintain transparent and strategic relationships at all levels within your merchants.  
  • Additional duties and responsibilities as necessary. 

What you’ll bring to the table: 

  • 4 - 6 years of experience in sales and merchant services in a related industry. 
  • Business Review experience with internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and foster a positive team culture. 
  • Established ability to build consultative and executive-level customer relationships. 
  • Solid conflict resolution abilities and negotiation experience. 
  • Advanced written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Desire to work in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Advanced experience in Microsoft Office Suite. 

Perks & Benefits: 

  • Medical and Wellness Benefits 
  • Life Assurance 
  • Income Protection 
  • Pension Scheme 
  • See Our High-Performing Culture >>> Check us out on Instagram (@lifeatshipbob) 

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions. 

About You: 

Building the world’s leading full-stack fulfillment platform is challenging work. The problems we solve are complex, the pace is fast, and the bar is high. That means ShipBob’s environment isn’t the right fit for everyone, and that’s okay. If you are ready to take ownership, push boundaries, and grow alongside a team that genuinely supports each other, we would love to hear from you. 

Learn more about our core values and how we perform at a high level in our day-to-day work on our Culture page (https://www.shipbob.com/careers/culture/). 

About Us:  

ShipBob is a leading global supply chain and fulfillment technology platform designed for SMB and Mid-Market ecommerce merchants to provide them access to best-in-class capabilities and to deliver a delightful shopper experience. Merchants can outsource their entire fulfillment operations, utilize ShipBob’s proprietary warehouse management system for in-house fulfillment, or take advantage of a hybrid solution across ShipBob’s dozens of fulfillment center network in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Europe, and Australia. ShipBob is backed by leading investors like Menlo Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, Hyde Park Venture Partners, and SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and is one of the fastest-growing tech companies headquartered in Chicago. 

At ShipBob, every full-time employee gets access to our best-in-class AI and productivity tools from Day 1 at no cost. This isn't a pilot or a perk for select teams. It's standard for everyone. We believe innovation isn't owned by one department. Whether you're in Talent, Operations, Finance, Engineering, or Customer Success, we expect you to ask: how can this be done better, faster, or smarter? These tools are our investment in your ability to find those answers.

Use of AI-Assisted Tools During Recruitment

We may use AI-assisted tools during the recruitment process to support administrative functions such as transcribing interviews, generating summaries or notes, organizing interview feedback, facilitating candidate communications, and helping recruiters identify candidates whose qualifications may align with job requirements. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and are not used to make final hiring decisions. Hiring decisions are made by trained human reviewers who consider the candidate's application, interview performance, qualifications, experience, and other relevant factors. AI-assisted tools do not independently determine whether a candidate advances in the hiring process or receives an offer of employment. Where required by applicable law, candidates will be provided with notice regarding our use of AI-assisted technologies and, where available, information about any applicable rights relating to such processing, including the ability to request additional information or opt out of certain AI-assisted processing activities. Candidates who exercise available opt-out rights may be reviewed through alternative processes consistent with applicable law.

ShipBob provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. 
 
This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. 

There is no deadline to apply for this position, as ShipBob accepts applications on an ongoing basis.

title: Regional Sales Director- UK
description:
Forward Networks is transforming how the world’s most complex networks are managed and secured. Founded in 2013 by four Stanford Ph.D.s, we built the industry’s first network digital twin — a mathematically precise model of the production network that gives IT teams unmatched visibility, verification, and agility across every major cloud and vendor environment.

Our customers include global leaders such as Goldman Sachs, PayPal, S&P Global, IBM, and Dell, as well as fast-growing enterprises and government agencies. According to IDC, Forward Networks customers realize an average of $14.2 million in annual benefits through improved efficiency and security.

Backed by world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Goldman Sachs, MSD Partners, and Threshold Ventures, Forward Networks offers a people-centric, innovative culture where brilliant minds are shaping the future of network reliability, security, and AI-ready operations.

Forward Networks is looking for an experienced Regional Sales Director UK

Do you want to create a category and help build a special company?
Do you want to sell a platform that solves real networking problems?
Do sensible quotas and no cap on earnings pique your interest?
Join a company that has been in the market 6+ years and has some of the top F500/Global 2000 and Federal agencies already buying and referenceable.

If you have 7-10 years of wildly successful experience selling to large enterprises and have also been on the journey of building a growth stage company...you may be the one!
We are building a special team and hope you consider us if you want to be part of changing the networking world as we know it. 

Responsibilities

  • Own the development and execution of your sales strategy in territory that aligns with the company's goals and objectives
  • Identify and qualify leads, and generate new Fortune 1000 opportunities in order to achieve quota on a quarterly and annual basis
  • Build strategic working relationships with clients, maintaining a high level of face-to-face contact
  • Analyze potential sales opportunities by using data analysis and segmented research to identify the attributes most valued by our potential clients
  • Develop a deep understanding of the competitive landscape and maintain a client database

Requirements

  • Minimum of 7-10 years in Enterprise Sales focused on large enterprises.
  • Proven track record of meeting and exceeding quota in technology sales
  • Deep understanding of the networking and security industry, products,
    competitors, history, emerging trends, and changing marketplace.
  • Experience in selling Enterprise software with an ARR model preferred
  • Must be able to communicate business and technical value to all levels of
    management
  • Excellent communication and listening skills; persuasive
  • Background in IT infrastructure

title: Senior People Partner - 12m FTC
description:
Senior People Partner - 12m FTC

London (Vauxhall)

Hybrid 2-3days per week

£79,000-85,000

The Role

ClearScore is looking for an experienced People Partner to join our People team on a maternity cover basis. This is a hands-on role in a fast paced environment, with responsibility across employee relations, performance, organisational change and People development.

You’ll inherit live casework and ongoing initiatives from day one, working closely with managers and People colleagues to provide practical, commercially-minded advice and deliver meaningful People initiatives across the business.

We’re looking for someone who can hit the ground running, is confident operating independently and enjoys balancing day-to-day People partnership with longer-term projects.

An interest in AI and how it can be applied practically within People would be a bonus.

 

 

What you will be doing:

Employee Relations & People Partnering

  • Own and manage end-to-end employee relations work, including absence management, underperformance, behavioural concerns, disciplinary and grievance processes.
  • Coach and support managers through complex and difficult conversations, ensuring they have the confidence and tools to manage People matters effectively.
  • Provide pragmatic, balanced advice that considers both employee experience and business needs.
  • Ensure People processes are applied consistently, fairly and appropriately.

Performance Management

title: Senior Systems Administrator (Linux)
description:
About Bluestaq Limited
Bluestaq starts with our people. We are looking for teammates who THINK strategically, SERVE the mission and LEAD from wherever they stand. If you bring curiosity, ownership and a thirst for delivery, we would like to hear from you.

Every society runs on invisible systems; Bluestaq is that, for data. Bluestaq Ltd is the UK sovereign subsidiary of Bluestaq LLC (Colorado Springs, USA), and we build the secure data infrastructure that allied operations depend on: mission-critical solutions, flowing through thousands of global users, from ingest to publication in milliseconds, for customers spanning the NATO, Five Eyes and wider allied partners.

We are in our formative years in the UK, building on proven foundations in the USA and Australia. That means real opportunity, early: decisions at your level, and colleagues who know their craft and trust you to know yours.

The Role
You will own specific Linux systems supporting our NATO delivery on AWS, from configuration and monitoring to upgrades and incident response. You will be the specialist the team escalates to when a fault defeats first-line troubleshooting, and you will improve reliability as well as restore it. 

You will mentor Systems Administrators in troubleshooting and operational hygiene. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the Systems Administration Manager, with a clear technical path to Lead Systems Administrator. 

What You Will Do 

  • Own one or more systems or environments, covering configuration, monitoring and alerting, upgrades and incident response. 
  • Debug difficult faults, including performance problems, resource exhaustion and integration failures, and take each incident from first symptom to a root cause and a remediation plan that holds. 
  • Configure and tune services with secure, hardened defaults, and turn scan output and logs into lasting remediation. 
  • Plan and execute upgrades and changes under change control, with realistic risk assessment and a tested rollback. 
  • Act as the escalation point for Systems Administrator colleagues, mentor them, and document patterns others can reuse in runbooks and standard operating procedures. 
  • Work across engineering, cyber and data teams on cross-functional problems. 
  • Take part in UK operational coverage, including on-call rotation and structured handovers with the US team. 

What You Bring 

  • Strong hands-on Linux systems administration in complex, secure production environments, with depth in service behaviour, performance tuning and hardened configuration. Experience on Microsoft Azure, VMware vSphere or similar platforms is transferable. 
  • Sound networking fundamentals, including DNS, DHCP, VLANs, firewalls and routing, and hands-on identity and access management across directory services and cloud platforms. 
  • Working experience with automation and infrastructure-as-code tooling such as Ansible, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker or Packer, and with patching discipline and configuration compliance in an accredited environment. 
  • Curiosity and incident discipline: you diagnose faults under pressure, find the root cause, and record what you found as well as what you fixed. 
  • Experience owning systems, escalating only genuinely novel problems, and mentoring less experienced colleagues deliberately. 
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including when the news is bad, and confident use of ITSM workflows and platforms such as Confluence and Jira. 
  • Judgement with AI tools: applying them where they help, reviewing what they produce and handling sensitive data responsibly. 

Essential Conditions 

  • Right to work in the UK. 
  • Ability to meet the security requirements above. 
  • Willingness to work 10-hour shifts on a four-on, four-off rota, including weekends and bank holidays. Night shifts may follow as further systems come online and the service moves to 24/7. 
  • Willingness and eligibility to travel to Bluestaq headquarters in the United States for onboarding, and occasionally to sites across the UK and Europe thereafter. 

Nice to Have 

  • Familiarity with NATO structures, the NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCIA), the MOD or other allied defence programmes. 
  • Linux certification such as RHCSA, RHCE or LPIC. 
  • CISSP, CompTIA Security+ or an equivalent security certification. 
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps or Secure by Design delivery. 
  • Experience with database administration or data-platform operations. 
  • A background in cloud, cyber security or C4ISR environments. 

Why Join Us 

  • Workplace pension through salary exchange. 
  • Group income protection and group life assurance from day one. 
  • 33 days’ annual leave including bank holidays, applied to your shift pattern. 
  • Private medical cover and 24/7 remote GP access for you and your family. 
  • Professional subscription support and ongoing development. 

Bluestaq Ltd is an Armed Forces Covenant signatory. Service leavers and reservists who know watch-keeping, escalation and operating under pressure will recognise this work. 

Apply
If you meet most of the criteria, apply through this listing with your CV. 

Join the Mission
Protect data that matters. Build capability the United Kingdom depends on. Launch into operations, not pitch decks.

Bluestaq Ltd is committed to an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, including career returners, service leavers, reservists and people underrepresented in defence technology. We recruit on capability and potential in line with the Equality Act 2010. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage, tell us when you apply. 

We are proud to support the Armed Forces Covenant. Service leavers and reservists who know watch-keeping, escalation and operating under pressure will find this role speaks their language.

When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by Bluestaq LLC ("Controller"), located at 2 S. Cascade Ave., Ste 200, Colorado Springs, CO 80903, contactable at ----- Controller’s data protection officer is Ashley Higgins, who can be contacted at -----

Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller's recruitment activities, including setting up and conducting interviews and assessments, evaluating results, and other steps in the recruitment and hiring process. This processing is lawful under Article 6(1)(f) of the UK GDPR as necessary for Controller's legitimate interests in soliciting, evaluating, and selecting applicants for employment.

Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider based in the United States engaged by Controller to help manage recruitment on its behalf. Your data will accordingly be transferred to the United States once submitted. Greenhouse is certified under the UK Extension to the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, which the UK government has confirmed provides an adequate level of protection for personal data transferred from the UK.

Your personal data will be retained for 180 days from the date of your application, reflecting the time limit (including possible extensions) for bringing recruitment-related legal claims in the UK, after which it will be deleted or anonymised. If you are hired, your application data will become part of your employee record, retained in accordance with our employee privacy notice.

Under the UK GDPR, you have the right to request access to, rectification of, or erasure of your personal data, and to request that processing be restricted. You also have the right to object to processing carried out on the basis of legitimate interests, and the right to data portability. You may lodge a complaint with the UK Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) at ico.org.uk or 0303 123 1113.

title: Staff Tech Lead, Web & Developer Products
description:
Our everyday digital experiences are in the middle of a realtime revolution: chatting alongside a livestream, getting realtime financial updates, or working with colleagues in a shared online space. Consumers now expect realtime as standard, and Ably powers a large part of it.

We put developers first. Our products help teams build, extend, and deliver realtime digital experiences, delivering over 700 billion messages to more than 2 billion devices every month. Teams at HubSpot, Fin, Dialpad, NASCAR, Sportsbet, and General Motors all build on Ably.

Working at Ably means helping build the infrastructure that will shape the next generation of the internet. More of what people do online is becoming live, shared and interactive, which only makes what we build more relevant and more necessary. AI is the latest place that shows up. There's still so much to build, and we'd like your help with it.

About this role

As the Staff Tech Lead for the Developer Experience team at Ably, you’ll report directly to our CTO and co-own the DevEx vision and strategy. You’ll lead the engineering team that owns our customer-facing web platform - our dashboard, documentation platform, and control plane - transforming it into a world-class experience for our users.

You are a senior, hands-on engineer who’s passionate about building for developers like yourself; someone who’ll obsess over the developer journey and elevate the user experience of the Ably platform. You’ll blend deep full-stack expertise with a strong product mindset, and lead a team of engineers working on initiatives where the feedback loop is immediate, because you and your team are the target users of the very ecosystem you are building.

Ably is an AI-forward organisation and this is a leadership role for an AI-first engineer. You must have confident, hands-on experience of AI-assisted development and be able to define how a team actually works with these tools day to day, and tell the difference between genuine leverage and noise.

Day to day you will

  • Obsess over developer experience. You’ll have broad responsibility for elevating how developers interact with Ably’s platform and services, partnering with the DevEx PM as a unified leadership team to deliver a developer experience that becomes a reference point for the industry.
  • Define and lead on AI-first working practices. You’ll be the catalyst and standard-setter for AI-enabled development across the team. You’ll leverage LLMs and AI tools to accelerate velocity, design workflows, set the guardrails and coach engineers to use them well - without compromising on engineering integrity.
  • Lead technical execution and vision. You’ll lead a team of five engineers building customer-facing web applications and own the technical architecture and design decisions for our dashboard, docs platform, marketing website, and billing UI.
  • Drive a product-first engineering culture. You’ll foster an environment where engineers are themselves principal stakeholders of product features, and obsess over customer outcomes. You’ll challenge the "feature factory" mentality and build a team that takes true ownership of the product.
  • Thrive in a rapid iteration environment. You’ll operate in a high-velocity workspace where PMs, customers, and engineers co-create features. You’ll lead the team in working full-stack to iterate, improve, and ship improvements quickly.
  • Guide engineering outcomes and quality. You’ll set and enforce high standards for code review, testing, and production readiness. You will participate in incident response and coordinate with the Infrastructure team on platform dependencies and deployments.
  • Mentor and grow the team. You’ll manage performance, career development, and hiring. You will hold the team accountable for delivery commitments while providing the mentorship needed to turn engineers into product-minded leaders.

We'd love to talk if you have

  • Real, demonstrable experience leading AI-first engineering. You champion the use of AI as a productivity multiplier for the team, and have led a team that ships with LLMs and AI tooling embedded in its daily workflow. You see AI as an enabler for higher velocity and output, not a replacement for engineering judgment, and hold strong, evidence-based views on what works and what doesn’t.
  • Extensive experience leading technical teams in technical B2B SaaS or API-first products, with a track record of product-minded engineering teams that take initiative and ownership of product outcomes.
  • A strong software engineering background with genuine full-stack fluency. You must have enough depth across the web stack to credibly lead and challenge senior web engineers. Hands-on experience with React and TypeScript is valuable, but sound engineering judgement and technical gravitas matter more than specific frameworks.
  • You have a natural empathy and strong instincts for what developer customers want because you are the target user. You are genuinely excited about building developer tools and can tap into immediate feedback loops. You understand API design, documentation, and the nuances that differentiate a great developer journey.
  • Experience at a startup or growth-stage company or adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment with a focus on rapid iteration. To be effective in this role you’ll need excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Bonus points if you have

  • Deep production experience building and shipping customer-facing web applications at scale with React and TypeScript.
  • Experience delivering solutions used by software developers (developer tooling or APIs) or similar technical personas.
  • An understanding of pub/sub and familiarity with distributed systems and event based architectures.

What’s it like to work at Ably?

You'll join a team of around 60 people, working directly alongside senior engineering and leadership. No layers, no bureaucracy, and real ownership from day one.

Remote-first

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

 

Annual gross salary range (package): €65,000 – €80,000
This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You’ll Do

1. Design & Build AI Systems

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.
  • Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.
  • Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.
  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack

  • Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.
  • Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.
  • Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.
  • Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact

  • Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.
  • Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.
  • Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.
  • Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.
  • Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.
  • Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.
  • Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement

  • Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.
  • Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.
  • Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.
  • Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL

  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems
  • Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products
  • Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact
  • Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and business impact
  • Performance and reliability of AI systems
  • Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Category Manager, Women's UK/EU

We are seeking a Senior Category Manager, Women's UK/EU to join our growing team. This role is suited to a data-driven product obsessed all-rounder. It supports the execution of merchandising strategy across selected womenswear categories, with responsibility for driving regional performance through strong product execution, trading, and customer insight. In this role, you will play a key part in scaling Quince’s value proposition in the UK & EU by delivering a compelling regional assortment, optimizing the customer experience, and partnering cross-functionally to bring high-quality products to market.

Responsibilities

  • Support end-to-end merchandising for selected womenswear categories in the UK & EU, including assortment execution, launches, and performance tracking
  • Execute regional merchandising strategy in partnership with US Product Merchandising and international regional merchandising peers
  • Contribute to product ideation, helping shape new product opportunities and business cases
  • Work cross-functionally with Product and Regional Merchandising, Planning, Marketing, Technical Design, and Sourcing to deliver successful product launches—balancing inventory, go-to-market execution, and product quality (fit, sizing, and margin)
  • Analyse trading performance (sales, returns, margin) and take ownership of actions to improve results
  • Support pricing and assortment decisions for the region
  • Own product catalogue management and administration, including product setup, data accuracy, and system maintenance
  • Build site merchandising strategy, including PDP improvements roadmap and customer journey optimisations
  • Monitor ratings, reviews, and returns to identify and support product quality improvements
  • Manage regional product samples and merchandising assets
  • Maintain merchandising reports, tools, trackers, and pricing files
  • Take ownership of evaluating regional product compliance requirements and partner with Sourcing and Quality teams to execute

Qualifications required: 

  • Role is based in one of our UK/EU offices (London, Madrid, or Berlin), with 4 days per week in-office requirement
  • 8 years of retail merchandising or buying experience in womenswear categories, with demonstrated ownership of category performance
  • E-commerce and/or DTC experience, with exposure to both startup and established (blue-chip) brands preferred
  • Proven track record of progressing within an organization and demonstrating continuous growth in roles and responsibilities
  • Strong product awareness, with a commercial mindset and attention to detail
  • Product obsessed, with experience leveraging data tools and external sources to drive results
  • Critical eye to anticipate customer needs (both the “science” and “art” of retail merchandising)
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using data to inform trading and merchandising decisions (e.g. sales, margin, return rates)
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in both executional and strategic support roles
  • Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as Planning, Design, Sourcing, or Marketing
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with particular ability to influence through concise written narrative
  • Motivated by working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, where flexibility to stretch into or out of functional comfort zones is crucial for team success
  • Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity and change
  • Bachelor’s Degree, preferred

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

description: Who We Are Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. About the Role: You will lead Notion’s GTM strategy and growth for France, one of EMEA’s largest and highest-priority markets. France is a Tier 1 region in Notion’s country-first EMEA model, with significant room to scale into a standalone, high-growth business. Notion is shifting from a traditional sales model toward a builder-led model with fewer handoffs, stronger technical fluency, and more direct ownership of customer outcomes. As General Manager, France, you will be the second-line leader responsible for overall revenue outcomes, regional GTM strategy, and the operating model for the French business. You will lead through frontline managers, teams of Business Development Representatives, Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects as well as partner cross functionally with Professional Services, Channel Partnerships and RevOps. This is a hands-on builder-leader role for an AI-native, country-first GTM model. You will bring Notion’s new GTM model to life in France: moving from a segment-first motion to a country-first, AI-native operating system where teams help customers diagnose problems, design agentic workflows, and build real systems with Notion AI. This role sits on the EMEA Leadership Team and reports to the General Manager, EMEA. This role will be based in Paris. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. What You'll Achieve: Own the GTM strategy, operating rhythm, and growth plan for France, with accountability for overall regional revenue outcomes across Sales Assist and Self Serve contribution. Lead as a second-line manager: hire, coach, and develop frontline leaders and IC teams across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, and supporting GTM functions. Scale a country-first GTM motion that brings Notion closer to French customers through local executive engagement, market nuance, and faster field-level decision-making. Accelerate the land engine by opening the right front doors, growing professional workspaces, increasing net-new and upgrade opportunities, and connecting self-serve signals to sales-assisted motion. Win lighthouse customers and turn them into market momentum by making them wildly successful, telling their story locally, and using those wins to influence peer companies across France. You will bring Notion’s new GTM model to life in France: moving from a segment-first motion to a country-first, AI-native operating system where teams help customers diagnose problems, design agentic workflows, and build real systems with Notion AI.

This role sits on the EMEA Leadership Team and reports to the General Manager, EMEA.

  • 12+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years leading SaaS or AI sales & GTM teams in France.

  • Deep knowledge of the French enterprise and startup ecosystem, including executive buyer networks, local partner channels, and market-specific buying dynamics across all market segments (commercial, midmarket and enterprise)

  • Proven second-line leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing frontline managers and high-performing IC teams.

  • Strong understanding of modern GTM motions across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services, Channel, Marketing, RevOps, and Product.

  • Builder mentality and deep AI curiosity: comfortable learning, demoing, and coaching teams on agent-first workflows, proof-of-value motions, and customer co-building.

About the Role:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

This role will be based in Paris, France. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

  • Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

  • Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

  • Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

  • Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

  • Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

  • Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

  • Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

  • Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

  • Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

  • You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

  • Fluency in English and French.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

  • Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

  • Experience in a shared account ownership model—able to navigate the SC/CSA hand-offs and hold the commercial arc across the full customer lifecycle

Firmenwagen: Für die Ausübung deiner Tätigkeiten stellen wir dir einen Firmenwagen zur Verfügung, damit du flexibel und komfortabel unterwegs bist - auch privat. Du hast freie Fahrzeugauswahl ! BIKELEASING: Du leistest dir dein Wunschfahrrad günstig über unser "Jobrad"-Programm. Umweltfreundlich und fit unterwegs – wir unterstützen dich dabei! Vielfältige Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von vermögenswirksamen Leistungen (VWL) und betrieblicher Altersvorsorge (BAV). Wir bieten dir zudem flexible Arbeitszeiten und freie Zeitgestaltung. Tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Unsere Arbeit lebt von einem positiven und kundenorientierten Umfeld. Nur wer selbst positiv eingestellt ist, kann auch andere begeistern. Gute Vergütung & Karrierechancen: Unsere Mitarbeitenden erhalten ein marktgerechtes Gehalt und können von zahlreichen weiteren Leistungen profitieren. Du hast zudem die Möglichkeit, über unser partizipatives Modell fortlaufend von den Erfolgen in der Umsetzung persönlich zu profitieren. Individuelle Entfaltungsmöglichkeiten: Spannende Projekte mit viel Potenzial für die eigene Entwicklung und ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget, das individuell eingesetzt werden darf. DEINE AUFGABENBEREICHE: Leitung von Projekten im Rahmen der S/4HANA-Transformation. Entwicklung und Anpassung von komplexen SAP-Logistikmodulen nach spezifischen Kundenanforderungen. Führung und Coaching von Junior Consultants und Teammitgliedern zur erfolgreichen Durchführung der Kundenprojekte. Eigenständige Umsetzung und Einführung von innovativen SAP-Technologien wie FIORI/UI5 und ABAP-Entwicklung. Beratung und Unterstützung unserer Kunden bei der Optimierung ihrer Logistikprozesse und der Implementierung neuer SAP-Lösungen. DEIN PROFIL: Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung zum Informatiker oder vergleichbares Studium. Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im SAP-Logistik-Umfeld. Tiefgehende Erfahrung in der ABAP-Entwicklung und/oder mit FIORI/UI5. Hervorragende analytische Fähigkeiten und eine lösungsorientierte Denkweise. Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und Teamfähigkeit. Führungsqualitäten und die Fähigkeit, Projekte und Teams erfolgreich zu managen. Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. title: Senior Consultant - Risque de marché et de contrepartie H/F
description:
Avec une stratégie de croissance, le groupe Capco renforce le développement de son pôle FRC (Finance, Risques & Conformité) et tout particulièrement son offre Risque, et recherche pour son bureau parisien des Senior consultant(e)s pour accompagner ses clients sur leurs enjeux de transformation réglementaire et organisationnelle liés au risque de marché et de contrepartie.

 

Votre rôle :

Chez nos clients :

  • Contribuer à l’identification et la gestion des risques liés aux activités de nos clients à travers la mise en place et la revue des dispositifs risques stratégiques (e.g. risk identification, risk appetite, ICAAP & Stress Testing, mitigation, monitoring & reporting),
  • Participer à la définition et la déclinaison opérationnelle des politiques métiers et risques, ainsi qu’à l’optimisation et l’industrialisation des processus et outils associés,
  • Accompagner nos clients dans leurs projets de mise en conformité réglementaire : analyse des textes réglementaires, gap analysis méthodologique/système/data/gouvernance/processus, préconisations et mise en œuvre, documentation et accompagnement du changement,
  • Intervenir en soutien des missions d’inspection interne et externe et des exercices de supervision (QIS, Benchmarking, Stress Testing, TRIM, mission d’homologation) : cadrage, coordination, documentation, traitement des recommandations.

 

Le profil recherché :

  • Titulaire d’une formation de type Bac+5 d’une école de commerce ou d’ingénieur, ou universitaire,
  • Vous avez de solides connaissances méthodologiques et de l’environnement réglementaire (Bâle III/IV, FBL/Volcker, EMIR) ainsi que sur le pricing des opérations de marché et la modélisation des risques afférents,
  • Une expérience des sujets data/digitaux appliqués à la fonction Risque (RPA, Machine learning, Big data), et des compétences solides en programmation et base de données sont des atouts forts,
  • Un excellent relationnel et un bon esprit d’équipe, on vous reconnait pour votre flexibilité, votre curiosité, votre créativité et votre envie d’accompagner activement la croissance d’un cabinet dynamique qui mise sur le management de proximité,
  • La maitrise du français et de l’anglais comme langues de travail est indispensable et vous savez évoluer avec aisance dans un contexte international,
  • Vous justifiez de 3 à 7 ans d’expérience dans le domaine du risque de marché et de contrepartie dont une période significative en cabinet de conseil en organisation, ou en gestion de projets avec une forte composante fonctionnelle au sein d’une institution financière.

 

Pourquoi choisir Capco ?

 

Créé en 1998, Capco est un cabinet de conseil en management et en organisation spécialisé dans le secteur des services financiers, avec 35 bureaux répartis entre l’Amérique, l’Asie et l’Europe et regroupant 7 000 collaborateurs dont 160 à Paris.

Notre offre conseil s’appuie sur trois grands domaines d’expertise : Business Consulting, Digital et Techonology

Chez Capco, nous vous offrons :

  • Un environnement de travail international centré sur l’innovation et la création de valeur pour nos clients bancaires et assuranciels
  • Un parcours de formation continu adapté à vos besoins, pour acquérir de nouvelles compétences et développer une réelle expertise
  • Une organisation de travail hybride (charte télétravail de 2 jours par semaine)
  • Une rémunération compétitive avec un bonus lié à la performance
  • Un PEE avec un abondement de 2903€ par an
  • Une culture d’entreprise entrepreneuriale, inclusive et méritocratique, de nouveau certifiée Great Place To Work®
  • Des initiatives pour construire le Capco de demain :
    • #BeYourselfAtWork
    • Woman@capco
    • RSE (forfait mobilité durable, jour de solidarité, etc.)
    • Des communautés métiers, sportives et culturelles
