title: Senior GTM System Builder
description:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

The commercial team at Mews moves deals through a complex, multi-touch GTM motion. The person in this role owns the systems that make that motion faster, smarter, and less dependent on manual effort — from inbound routing and deal enrichment to Gong-driven coaching intelligence and CPQ automation. This is not a support role for the commercial team. It is an ownership role for the infrastructure they run on.

You will join the Growth team to own an assigned domain within the GTM stack end to end: scoping, building, shipping, and running production systems that move ARR. You will work under staff technical direction but make your own architecture and build-vs-buy decisions within your domain. You will manage vendor relationships, define observability standards, and be the person who picks up the phone when something breaks in production.

What you would do

  • Own the full lifecycle of automation and AI-tooling initiatives within your assigned GTM pod: scoping, building, shipping to production, and iterating based on adoption and KPI data — not just ticket completion
  • Build and ship AI-powered pipelines that permanently remove manual GTM work: deal enrichment, outbound research and routing, Gong-driven coaching signals, forecasting inputs, CPQ automation, and proposal follow-up
  • Design the prompting architecture and agent logic that commercial reps, BDRs, and AEs interact with daily — reliable outputs for non-technical end users, with observability and error handling built in from the start
  • Own operational health of your domain's live systems: first responder when things break, with adoption metrics, error rates, and data quality visibility instrumented before deployment
  • Manage vendor relationships at pod level (Gong, Clay, LeanData, ZoomInfo, depending on assignment): SLAs, incident escalation, business reviews, and periodic build-vs-buy re-decisions
  • Support other engineers through code review, pairing, and coaching on architecture trade-offs — and contribute reusable patterns and integrations that accelerate delivery across pod

AI Fluency Level 4: In this role, AI is not a productivity layer — it is the product. You will architect and ship LLM-powered agents, enrichment pipelines, and AI-assisted automations that the commercial org depends on. You will make engineering decisions about models, infrastructure, and MCP integrations. You will design prompting systems that non-technical users rely on without ever touching a prompt themselves. The test for everything you build is whether a KPI moved — which means your judgment about where AI is trustworthy and where it needs a human in the loop is part of the work, not an afterthought.

For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates on Confluence.

What you would bring

  • 4 to 6 years delivering production software with measurable commercial impact in a product-driven company (high-growth SaaS, startup, or scale-up)
  • Demonstrated end-to-end ownership with strong autonomy: you have defined the approach, navigated genuine ambiguity, and owned the outcome — not executed tickets
  • Has shipped AI-powered pipelines or agents in a real operational context: enrichment, routing, summarization, or AI-assisted automation — not just prototypes
  • Active practitioner of modern AI development tooling (Claude, Lovable, Cursor, or equivalent) and comfortable working with LLM APIs and MCP integrations — AI Fluency Level 4 or the equivalent hands-on engineering experience
  • Hands-on experience building against Salesforce or equivalent CRM APIs: workflows, event-driven logic, and data integrations across multiple systems
  • Comfortable owning live production systems: incident response, observability, vendor management, and data integrity — draws no hard line between building and running
  • Can translate operational pain into technical requirements and explain technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Nice to have

  • Experience in or alongside a RevOps or GTM function — understands what commercial reps actually need, not the idealized version
  • Hands-on experience with Gong API, Clay, LeanData, or ZoomInfo integrations
  • Familiarity with Nue/CPQ, Databricks, HubSpot, Hook, or Ada

Pay Transparency at Mews

This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.

If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.

What’s in it for you?

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

Global benefits

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

  • Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
  • Participation in our company share program
  • Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
  • An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
  • Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
  • A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
  • Relocation options, available after one year
  • Flexible, hybrid working options
  • A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance
  • Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

Local benefits

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

Life at Mews

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

  • High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.
  • Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.
  • We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.
  • AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.

If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.

We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.

One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.

If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
We pioneered the Organic SolidFlow battery

CMBlu Energy is on an exciting journey towards becoming a global cleantech company. Our mission is to enable unlimited energy storage modelled on nature - for everyone, worldwide.   

What are SolidFlow batteries?  

SolidFlow batteries store energy in organic molecules. The absence of explosive materials makes them safe, the use of socially and ecologically conflict-free raw materials makes them sustainable and the almost unlimited availability of materials makes them scalable and cheap to procure. This makes our patented SolidFlow technology a game changer in the development of a global climate-neutral energy system.   

From start-up to scale-up: we're tackling it together  

CMBlu Energy is developing from a start-up focussing on research into a manufacturing scale-up that is on its way to series production. Around 240 employees are working towards this goal at CMBlu Energy. Our head office is in Alzenau near Frankfurt, with a branch office in Obernburg. There are also subsidiaries in Athens, Greece and Petaluma, USA.  

 

Your Responsibilities 

  • You define, prioritize, and steer the technical tasks of the negolyte development team in our agile framework, and you own the team backlog and translate company objectives into data-driven development priorities. 
  • You make transparent, data- and fact-based prioritization decisions and drive rapid build-measure-learn iterations with clear traceability, fostering an outcome-oriented, collaborative way of working. 
  • You are the central point of technical accountability in the project team and ensure visibility and shared understanding of backlog, roadmap, and development priorities. 
  • You drive technical trade-off decisions between development teams and system design, balancing performance, stability, manufacturability, and cost, and ensure component-level development is compatible with the overall system. 
  • You identify and mitigate scale-up, sourcing, and processing risks early and support pilot-scale validation. 
  • You contribute to the IP strategy, including filing your own patent applications and assessing the IP landscape of competitors. 

Your Profile 

  • Completed doctorate or master’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or comparable qualification 
  • Experience in product ownership, R&D project management, or technical program management in a complex development environment 
  • Experience with agile development methods, backlog management, and cross-functional collaboration 
  • Solid understanding of electrochemistry, battery systems, or materials development is an advantage 
  • Strong prioritization and outcome-focused decision-making skills, combined with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills 
  • Structured, collaborative, and solution-oriented way of working, with the ability to balance technical, organizational, and business requirements 

 

Your benefits at CMBLU Energy AG

  • More net pay for you: Enjoy an extra €50 tax-free every month with your Spendit Card (pro-rata for part-time employees). Use it flexibly at numerous Visa acceptance points in your region – wherever it suits you. Your Spendit Card also gives you access to Wellhub, connecting you with gyms, fitness classes and wellness offers across Germany.
  • Sustainable mobility: We cover the full cost of your Deutschland-Ticket, a nationwide public transport pass valid on all local and regional trains, buses, trams, and subways across Germany. Additionally, you can lease the bike of your choice at attractive rates through JobRad. Whether you prefer train or bike, we make it easier for you to travel comfortably and sustainably.
  • Share in our success: Our Virtual Stock Option Program (VSOP) gives you the opportunity to share in CMBLU’s success and growth. Simply put, you receive virtual shares without having to make a personal investment and without voting rights. As CMBLU grows in value, you can benefit financially from that growth.
  • Fresh and delicious food for your workday: At our Alzenau site, you can enjoy fresh, subsidized meals every day from our freshtaste meal vending machine.
  • Learn languages your way: With Busuu, you can improve your language skills at your own pace and with maximum flexibility. We provide you with free access to the language-learning platform.
  • Purpose that drives you: Help shape the energy transition with us and contribute to the further development of our SolidFlow battery. Since 2026, CMBLU has been a unicorn, meaning our company is valued at more than one billion euros. Through your work, you actively help shape this growth.
  • A culture that connects: At CMBLU, the values of reliability, innovation, and relentlessness shape our collaboration. This is also lived out beyond everyday work: at a shared BBQ, an end-of-year celebration, or team sports activities. We celebrate our successes together, because they are the result of teamwork.

We look forward to reimagining the future of energy together with you.

Apply now and be a part of our exciting journey.

ROLLER is not your average software-as-a-service company. About the Role

The Solution Engineer owns the end-to-end pre-sales process at ROLLER, commercial and technical. You partner with Account Executives to qualify, progress, and earn new business, while simultaneously running the technical validation that gives prospects the confidence to buy.

What sets a ROLLER SE apart is the combination. You carry the commercial rigour of a quota-carrying rep; MEDDICC discipline, value-based discovery, and business case ownership alongside the technical credibility to design and deliver compelling solutions. On the most complex deals, you'll have access to a Solution Architect as a force multiplier, which frees you to stay focused on the commercial motion where you create the most value.

  • Champion MEDDICC qualification across your pipeline: identifying Economic Buyers, mapping Decision Criteria and Process, surfacing Implicated Pain, and maintaining a clear, honest view of deal health at all times
  • Lead technical & value based discovery with prospects, diagnosing operational and revenue pain points and connecting them explicitly to the value ROLLER delivers
  • Own the technical pre-sales process: running tailored product demonstrations, managing technical validation, and handling integration and configuration questions across the standard deal motion
  • In support with the AE, and our Business Value Consultant, present ROI-led business cases framed in the language of the Economic Buyer; revenue growth, cost reduction, and operational efficiency, not feature lists
  • Own competitive positioning in live deals, handling objections and neutralising competitor narratives with confidence and evidence
  • Partner closely with Account Executives on deal strategy, account planning, and executive engagement — presenting alongside them to C-suite stakeholders when the deal calls for it
  • Engage Solution Architects on your most complex, high-value opportunities. You'll brief them in, stay close to the commercial thread, and ensure technical depth doesn't slow the deal down
  • Respond to RFPs and RFIs, owning the commercial and functional positioning while leveraging SA support on technically deep sections
  • Collaborate with Customer Success on expansion and upsell motions with existing customers, applying the same qualification and value-selling approach to growth as to new logo.

  • Feed commercial insights; win patterns, loss reasons, and competitive intelligence back to Sales leadership to sharpen the overall motion

  • Fluent in English (written and verbal), with the ability to communicate confidently with internal teams and stakeholders across EMEA and globally.

  • 3+ years in a Solution Engineer, Sales Engineer, or commercial pre-sales role within a SaaS company
  • Deep, practised familiarity with MEDDICC or an equivalent qualification methodology. You use it as a daily operating lens, not an occasional reference
  • Genuine commercial instinct: you think in business outcomes and ROI, and you can articulate ROLLER's value in terms that resonate with a CFO or Head of Operations
  • Technical confidence to run demos, handle product and integration questions, and manage a standard technical evaluation.

  • Experience with Salesforce as your CRM of record
  • Familiarity with value or solution selling frameworks (Command of the Message, Challenger, SCIPAB) is a strong advantage
  • Experience in leisure, attractions, hospitality, or entertainment is a plus, but commercial instinct and methodology matter most

Nice to have:

  • Experience with API concepts and standard integration patterns, enough to have an informed conversation without an SA in the room
  • Exposure to ROLLER's product categories: ticketing, POS, memberships, waivers, self-serve kiosks, payments

  • Experience in pre-sale (Solution Architecture, Solution Engineering, Sales) is a plus

Analyze commercial performance: Understand how our products perform across customer segments, sales cycles, usage, and revenue. Improve pricing and packaging: Identify opportunities to strengthen our commercial offering, increase conversion, and unlock expansion. Understand the market: Stay close to competitors, industry developments, and emerging customer requirements. What We're Looking For 2+ years of experience in Product Management, Solutions Consulting, Pre-Sales, or a comparable customer-facing role. Strong technical understanding and experience working closely with engineering teams. Strong commercial judgment and an understanding of what drives customer adoption, conversion, and revenue. Analytical skills and the ability to turn customer feedback, market signals, and performance data into clear recommendations. Excellent communication skills in English; German is a plus. A proactive, hands-on mindset with high ownership and the confidence to challenge assumptions. Experience using AI tools in your daily work. Procurement experience is a plus, but not required. We're looking for someone who can quickly understand a complex market and connect customer needs with real business opportunities. Why Join Lio? Shape how enterprise AI reaches the market: Influence both our product direction and how we position and sell our AI agents. Work at the intersection of product and revenue: Your work will directly contribute to winning customers and growing our business. Collaborate with exceptional teams: Work closely with engineers, sales leaders, and enterprise customers to solve complex problems. Build for real-world impact: Help bring AI agents into production at some of the world's largest organizations. High ownership, low bureaucracy: Take initiative, move fast, and have a meaningful voice in how we grow. Our product is growing fast with more than 1,500 clients already relying on it and an ambitious roadmap to scale fast.

About the role:

As our Product Manager (PO / PM), you will own product delivery across the full scope of the Dedale platform, end-to-end, from discovery to shipped feature. You will join our product and engineering team, report directly to the CPO, and work closely, day to day, with our 30+ data team, our research team, and our external design partner.

You own your product area end-to-end: talk to internal and external users, shape the roadmap with the CPO, write the specs, guide the engineering team and drive delivery to launch. You own outcomes, not hand-offs: you decide what ships, define what “good” looks like, and make sure it lands. High-impact, high-autonomy, with a clear path toward Lead Product Manager and Product Director.

One specificity of product at Dedale: our software is only as strong as the data beneath it. So part of the role is keeping the product and data roadmaps in step and working with our Head of Data and Senior Data Engineer so features and the data they rely on are ready together.Staying curious about new tools and approaches, and bringing that curiosity to the team.

Your first 3 months:

  • First 2 weeks: get to know the platform, the users and the team, and take the backlog in hand

  • First month: own the backlog and ship your first releases, at a steady cadence

  • By month 3: run your product area end-to-end, discovery to launch; owning the roadmap, the quality bar, and the outcomes for your area

Your Key Responsibilities:

Product Ownership & Delivery

  • Own the roadmap and a well-groomed backlog for the product, set with the CPO and prioritized on user value and impact

  • Write crisp user stories, specs and acceptance criteria the engineering team can build from

  • Partner with the engineering team to ensure they have all they require to ship in an agile and pro-active approach

  • In alignment with the Head of Engineering, make scope and trade-off calls transparently, balancing value, effort and readiness

Discovery & User Value

  • Talk to users (investors, analysts, research and go-to-market teams) and turn their pain points into problems worth solving

  • Validate ideas quickly (user interviews, prototypes, data spot-checks) before committing build effort

  • Brief and partner with our external design agency; frame the problem, review designs in Figma, keep the bar high

  • Define success metrics and track them post-release in PostHog (adoption, usage, satisfaction)

Quality & Reliability

  • Own the definition of done and release acceptance: the product works, and the data behind it is correct, before it ships

  • Hold a high quality bar: catch regressions, triage and prioritize bugs, fix root causes

  • Monitor releases post-launch (usage, errors, data quality) and close the loop fast

  • Partner with the engineering team to maintain a buffer for continuous improvement of the product and ensuring an increasing quality day-by-day

  • Partner with engineering and data on test coverage and release readiness

Keeping Tech & Data in sync our specificity, with the Head of Data and Senior Data Engineer

  • Co-plan releases so each feature and its data land together: no feature waiting on data, no data with nowhere to go

  • Keep a shared view of what data (pipelines, enrichment, tagging, taxonomies) must be ready for which feature, and by when

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Keep leadership, go-to-market and research stakeholders aligned on roadmap, progress and trade-offs and be the reliable translator between technical, data and business audiences

What we are looking for:

Must-haves:

  • 3 to 6 years as a Product Owner and/or Product Manager on a software product (ideally B2B SaaS)

  • Strong agile delivery track record: backlog ownership, clear specs, and a habit of shipping regularly

  • Solid product and business sense: you run discovery, understand needs and usage, prioritize well, and define and track success metrics

  • Comfortable with data: you have worked on a product with a real data layer and can hold your own with data engineers on coverage and quality

  • Fluent English is essential: it is our common working language, and many of the team don’t speak French. French is a plus, not a requirement

  • Exposure to AI / LLM-powered features, search or retrieval products

Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with private equity, financial services, market intelligence or data-provider environments

  • Analytical and hands-on: comfortable checking things yourself in SQL or a BI/analytics tool

  • Experience with taxonomies, metadata, knowledge bases or content-heavy platforms

Who you are:

  • You treat a feature as unfinished until it is genuinely done (working, tested, and the data correct) while balancing pace of shipping

  • You are proactive and curious, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike

What we offer:

  • High autonomy and direct impact from day one

  • A collaborative, intellectually stimulating environment at the intersection of data, AI and decision-making

About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

We offer a highly competitive compensation package with On-Target Earnings (OTE), designed to reward high performance and results. This includes a strong base salary complemented by an uncapped commission structure, meaning there is no limit to what you can earn — your success directly drives your income. Building on this performance-driven culture, not every candidate ticks every box — and that’s why we value individuals with a growth mindset who bring potential, initiative, and a willingness to learn.

Collaborate with customers and partners to strengthen their security posture. About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

Senior Specialist, T2 (Target2) Payment Operations 

Location: Remote in Netherlands, Spain, Cyprus or Poland

The role

We’re moving from indirect to direct participation in TARGET2 (T2), and we need someone to own the operational side end to end. You’ll design and document the Payment Operations processes, validate them in the August UAT, cut over BIC by BIC, and then run them as business-as-usual. You’ll be the operational contact for the T2 scheme, DNB and our partner banks.

What you’ll do

  • Own core payment processes: SCT / SCT Inst recalls, investigations (including pacs.028), SWIFT enquiries (MT199/MT999, RFIs), missing or incoming funds, and rejects, returns and refunds.
  • Run the T2 platform day to day: work in the T2 GUI (U2A/A2A), maintain CRDM reference data, and set up four-eyes controls and the manual-vs-automated split.
  • Manage the migration: move traffic from BNP Paribas to direct participation, with every payment traceable by BIC and path, and define when each BNPP-dependent step can be retired.
  • Cover reconciliation and liquidity: be the Payment Ops link to the reconciliation team (funding and defunding stay with Finance Ops/Treasury).
  • Handle incidents and contingency: build the incident process around DNB, FIS and TARGET escalation routes, own Payment Ops’ role in DNB reporting, and define the ECONS II contingency approach.
  • Coordinate with others: work with the Eurosystem, DNB, SWIFT/NEXI, FIS and correspondent banks, and partner with Product and Engineering to specify how the platform should behave.

What success looks like

  • Every direct-participation process has an owner, documented procedures, and passing UAT evidence.
  • The migration causes no impact on customers, and Customer Support has clear guidance.
  • After go-live, T2 runs as stable BAU with no remaining BNPP operational dependency.

What we’re looking for

  • Hands-on experience with T2 / TARGET Services (RTGS, TIPS), including the GUI and U2A/A2A actions
  • Around 2-3+ years in payment operations at a bank, EMI or PSP, ideally with SEPA schemes (SCT, SCT Inst)
  • Familiarity with investigations, recalls, returns and SWIFT / ISO 20022 messaging
  • Experience writing SOPs and controls, or the ability to pick it up quickly
  • Comfort working with regulators, partners and technical teams
  • Enough ownership to make sign-off and escalation decisions with support from the team
  • Fluent English

Nice to have

  • Experience with CRDM reference-data maintenance
  • Involvement in a direct-participation onboarding or sponsor-bank migration
  • Knowledge of DNB / TARGET-NL conditions, IPR, PSD2, or ECONS II contingency processes
What You Will Get In Return
 
Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
 
Become a stock options holder
 
Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
 
Equal Opportunity Statement 
 
At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing space hardware for leading-edge communications satellites, we would like to hear from you. The ideal candidate will be versatile and proficient in mechanical analysis, electronics packaging, computer-aided design (CAD), mechanical interfaces, thermal architecture, spacecraft propulsion, deployable and actuated structures, and environmental qualification of spacecraft antennas and payloads. A Master's degree may count as two years of experience. Experience in conducting architectural trade studies including parametric and first-order cost and physical analysis Experience with professional mechanical and FEA CAD tools, such as Ansys Mechanical, SolidWorks Simulation, and Thermal Desktop Experience with CNC manufacturing and GD&T Experience with advanced aerospace manufacturing and materials including sandwich panels and carbon composites, OR experience with high-reliability deployment mechanisms for space applications (including deployment, HDRMs, power delivery, etc.). Proficiency in detailed mechanical design (3D CAD, drawings, etc.) Experience designing and manufacturing mechanisms and mechanical actuators Experience with EMI/EMC mitigation techniques Familiarity with satellite thermal architectures including heat pipes, phase change materials, contact resistance, and surface finishes as well as fundamental understandings of orbital thermal control in a LEO environment. Familiarity with launch and LEO environments (thermal, shock, vibe, radiation, etc) Familiarity with design for test, manufacturability, assembly, and reliability Excellent written and verbal communication skills PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Python, C++, or other programming languages Experience with large, deployable antenna arrays which drive your vision for the next generation of on-orbit communications and sensor arrays. Robotics and control systems experience PCBA experience. CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. You’ll be joining a people-focused company, and as a Principal Product Manager , you will get the ability to define and drive product development for multiple high-growth, high-visibility products. Supported by a top-flight sales organization and high-powered engineering team. And massive potential for going both deep and wide into current and future verticals by leveraging our large and highly engaged audience. THE OPPORTUNITY Work on a small but mighty team of product managers assigned to specific products. Own and execute high-impact product development roadmaps to scale growth developing the overall product strategy and roadmap. Adapt and modify product and business requirements based on quantitative and qualitative results supported by routine and regular statistical experimentation. Work closely with Vendavo’s User Centered Design team to ensure that the product delivers a delightful user experience. Present our new products to field staff and prospects as each generation of our SaaS products are deployed. Work hand-in-hand with a dedicated cross-functional team of executive business sponsors and product, marketing, business operations, finance, CS, and trust partners to optimize user retention and revenue across consumer-facing products and touchpoints. Act as a champion for Vendavo’s mission, vision, and values and partner across the company to drive a high-performance work environment. Other duties as assigned. THE SKILL SET Experience - Have 10+ years of relevant work experience in product management at a high-performance SaaS consumer technology company. B2B SaaS Experience (Preferred) - Experience in B2B SaaS, with CPQ, Rebates, or Pricing management as a nice-to-have but not mandatory requirement. Product Lifecycle Expertise - Must have experience leading at least two full product lifecycles from ideation to launch and post-launch iterations. Agile Product Development - Strong knowledge of agile methodologies with experience managing iterative, high-quality product releases. Customer-Centric Focus - Ability to understand customer needs and translate them into valuable product features and solutions. Data-Driven Decision Making - Skilled in leveraging data and analytics to inform product decisions and prioritize features. Cross-Functional Leadership - Proven ability to lead and collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, sales, marketing) to ensure product success. Problem-Solving and Critical Thinking - Ability to think strategically, solve complex problems, and make sound decisions in fast-paced environments. Execution Excellence - Strong project management skills to ensure products are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business goals. THE VENDAVO STORY Vendavo partners with the world’s leading companies to accelerate growth and profitability, advance innovation, and build more prosperous communities. Our powerful, cloud-based, AI-powered pricing, selling, and prescribing solutions empower global manufacturers and distributors to manage, optimize, and digitize their end-to-end commercial processes. But we offer so much more than software. Our proven, repeatable process, and passionate, experienced people accelerate value and drive profitable, unrivaled business outcomes for our customers. We are passionate about helping our customers deliver the right products, at the right prices, at the right time, for the right people. OUR SAAS PRODUCTS Our B2B pricing and selling solutions include Vendavo’s Pricing & Strategy Management (Pricepoint, Enterprise Pricing Platform, Deal Price Optimizer, and Vendavo AI), Sales & Quoting Solutions (Intelligent CPQ and Sales Optimizer), Profit and Margin Analytics (Profit Analyzer and Margin Bridge Analyzer), and Incentive & Channel Operations (Rebate and Channel Manager). You can learn more about our products here . OUR FUNDING We are backed by two of the top high-tech private equity firms in the world, have excellent financial health, and boast the top SaaS retention in our space. OUR CULTURE & YOU We collaborate with our customers unlike any others in our industry. Anchored in our values (Integrity, Customer Centricity, Innovation, Clarity, Collaboration), we are growing, constantly innovating, and consistently driving sustainable outcomes for our clients and partners. Unlocking opportunities for our customers would not be possible without our employees. When you are part of Vendavo, you’re part of a company that’s committed to your growth and invested in your career. Diversity, inclusion, and celebration of community are at our core, and we come together to learn from each other and honor our commitments. Du begleitest Interessenten und Neukunden vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Buchung. Du erkennst Schwachstellen, hinterfragst Abläufe und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns sinnvolle Verbesserungen. Das bringen Du mit Must-have Organisationstalent: Du liebst es, Dinge zu strukturieren, zu koordinieren und den Überblick zu behalten – auch wenn zehn Dinge gleichzeitig passieren. Eigenverantwortung & Zuverlässigkeit: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass Dir jemand sagt, was als Nächstes zu tun ist. Du denkst mit, setzt Prioritäten und kümmerst Dich darum, dass Dinge erledigt werden. Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis: Du arbeitest Dich schnell in neue Software und digitale Systeme ein und hast Freude daran, technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen. Digitale Affinität: Du organisierst Dich lieber mit digitalen Tools, Aufgabenboards und smarten Workflows als mit dem guten alten Notizblock. 😉 Lösungsorientiertes Denken: Du erkennst Probleme, übernimmst Verantwortung und suchst aktiv nach Lösungen, statt darauf zu warten, dass andere sie finden. Ein modernes, digitales Arbeitsumfeld: Wir setzen auf smarte Tools, effiziente Prozesse und neue Technologien statt auf unnötige Bürokratie. Ein freundliches, motiviertes Team: Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, kommunizieren auf Augenhöhe und ziehen gemeinsam an einem Strang. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung: Kurze Wege, ehrliche Kommunikation und schnelle Entscheidungen. Gestaltungsspielraum: Deine Ideen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht. Wenn Du einen besseren Weg findest, möchten wir davon hören. Überwiegend Homeoffice & maximale Flexibilität: Du arbeitest grundsätzlich remote und kannst Deine Arbeit flexibel von zu Hause aus gestalten. Unser Geschäftsbüro in Leverkusen steht Dir jederzeit als alternativer Arbeitsplatz und für persönliche Treffen mit dem Team zur Verfügung. Vertrauen statt Kontrolle: Wir setzen auf ein sehr hohes Maß an gegenseitigem Vertrauen, Eigenverantwortung und selbstständigem Arbeiten. Flexibilität für Kundentermine: Während Deiner Arbeitszeiten solltest Du bereit sein, bei Bedarf auch persönlich zu Kundenterminen zu fahren. Dafür bist Du mobil und kannst Termine eigenständig wahrnehmen. Faire, entwicklungsgerechte Vergütung: Mit wachsender Erfahrung und Verantwortung kann sich auch Deine Vergütung weiterentwickeln. Intensive Einarbeitung: Wir nehmen uns die Zeit, Dich mit unseren Dienstleistungen, Systemen und Prozessen vertraut zu machen. Passt Du zu uns? Jemanden, der auch dann den Überblick behält, wenn es mal hektisch wird. Der gerne mit Menschen spricht, technisch fit ist, eigenständig Lösungen findet und sich nicht davor scheut, Fehler zu machen und daraus zu lernen. Uns ist nicht nur wichtig, was Du kannst, sondern vor allem, wer Du bist. Passt Du zu uns?

Wir suchen keinen Menschen, der einfach nur seine To-do-Liste abarbeitet.

Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt und Freude daran hat, Dinge am Laufen zu halten.

Uns ist nicht nur wichtig, was Du kannst, sondern vor allem, wer Du bist.

Do work that matters.

At AlertMedia, we help organizations protect their people, operations, and brand. Our modern Risk Intelligence and Response platform empowers teams to detect emerging threats, assess impact, and respond with confidence. We believe building resilience should be simpler—and it starts with bringing critical information and workflows together in one unified platform.

Our core values drive us in our important mission of keeping people safe & informed:

  • We’re humans not robots
  • Customers always come first
  • We work better together
  • Simplicity is our strength
  • Our reputation is priceless
  • Hard work pays off

As one of the fastest-growing software companies in the country, AlertMedia is looking for a Sr. Software Engineer with strong backend engineering experience and the ability to contribute across the full stack. This role is an opportunity to use a wide variety of design and technical web skills to help us develop and support features for the AlertMedia product suite. As an AI-forward company, we actively use modern AI tools such as Claude, Codex, and other emerging technologies to help our engineers work smarter, move faster, and build better products.

Who you are:

You thrive in a collaborative engineering environment that plays to everyone's strengths with a willingness to work across the entire stack. You have experience developing scalable production applications using modern backend technologies, ideally Python or Elixir. You care about the quality of your work, the impactful product you help build, and the team you help build it with. You have AWS (or other cloud) experience and are willing to learn from people with both more and less experience than you. You are a user of AI-assisted development tools that improve engineering workflows, code quality, and team productivity.

What you get to do every day:

  • Design and develop features for the AlertMedia product suite
  • Learn the AlertMedia platform and tools, and its uses for our customers
  • Work with Python, Elixir, JavaScript, Next.js, React and other web technologies
  • Use AI-enabled tools such as Claude, Codex, and other emerging platforms to support development, problem-solving, documentation, and productivity
  • Work in an Agile based environment using tools like Git, JIRA, Jenkins, and Slack

  • Use strong verbal and written communication skills in collaboration with other engineering and product teams
  • Contribute to AlertMedia’s culture, values and vision for the future

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as computer science, computer engineering or related field preferred
  • 6+ years of hands-on software engineering experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable production applications, preferably using Python, Django, Elixir, or JavaScript
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and writing unit and integration tests
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and container orchestration tools such as Kubernetes
  • Hands-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining applications in AWS or similar cloud environments
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, or similar database and caching technologies
  • Experience making architectural decisions, evaluating technical tradeoffs, and owning engineering initiatives from design through implementation
  • Active user of AI tools and modern developer platforms to enhance engineering quality, velocity, and collaboration
  • Collaborative mindset to partner with principal engineers and leadership to drive architectural evolution for a critical application
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage working on multiple projects in parallel
  • The ability and desire to work in a fast-paced challenging environment

raw.jobDescription:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We’re building a high-performance CI/CD execution platform similar to runners used by tools like Buildkite, GitHub Actions, and Blacksmith CI. Our platform executes developer pipelines reliably at scale, integrates deeply with source control, and automates build, test, and deployment workflows.

In this role, you will design and build the distributed systems responsible for running CI/CD pipelines securely and efficiently. This includes orchestrating ephemeral compute environments, managing build isolation, scheduling jobs across fleets of workers, and ensuring reliability at scale.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Design and improve the core orchestration engine that manages the lifecycle of creating, merging, and rebasing Supabase Branches.

  • Provision ephemeral sandboxed execution environment on EKS / ECS for running untrusted build workloads from connected git repositories with securely managed secrets.

  • Implement job scheduling that scale to thousands of concurrent builds.

  • Optimize and reduce pipeline runtimes with caching, artifact storage, and dependency reuse.

  • Manage retry, timeout, cancellation, and failure-propagation logic to ensure pipelines behave predictably under failure conditions.

  • Instrument the full pipeline lifecycle with observability tooling to surface traces, metrics, and structured logs to the end user.

  • Develop configuration files (JSON / TOML) and integrations (Terraform / Pulumi) that allow teams to easily define, trigger, and inspect pipelines in code.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

  • Have strong software engineering skills (Go and Typescript required);

  • Have 3+ years of experience building and operating cloud infrastructure or distributed systems at scale;

  • Have cloud Infrastructure knowledge - familiarity with AWS constructs is required, past experience using the AWS SDKs and IaC tools (Pulumi, Terraform, etc) to build and operate infrastructure is strongly preferred.

  • Have a production operations mindset - track record of building reliable, observable, and maintainable systems

  • Have an ownership mindset - you thrive in being able to operate independently with high-level guidance

  • Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Have experience in async or globally distributed teams

  • Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

By integrating reliable, secure, and robust data streaming capabilities into the Snappy ecosystem, we are setting new standards in the industry for ease of development, implementation, management and security. raw.jobDescription:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Data API Engineer to join our Data API Team and help improve the feature set, reliability and performance of our Data API, based on the PostgREST project.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Work on PostgREST’s PostgreSQL driver (based on Hasql) and remove bottlenecks and improve it’s performance.

  • Work on PostgREST development of new features and bug fixes, aligned towards the goal of a multitenant Data API.

  • Resolve incidents and escalated support issues, while also improving observability and performance.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with other teams to debug and solve integration issues with the Supabase platform.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

  • Strong Haskell skills with at least 3 years of experience.

  • Experience using the C language.

  • Solid knowledge of SQL and plpgsql scripting in PostgreSQL.

  • Strong track record of contributing to and engaging with open-source projects. Bonus points if you’ve maintained an open source project.

  • Strong experience with providing technical support to users with varying levels of technical expertise.

  • Experience with debugging applications under the Linux operating system.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Senior Manager Continuous Improvement
description:
About Us 

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world. 

AI at SharkNinja

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

About the Role

Based remotely and reporting to the Sr. Vice President, Global Logistics, the Senior Manager, Continuous Improvement will play a critical leadership role in driving cost savings, service improvement, and operational excellence across SharkNinja's Operations organization. This individual will own the visibility, governance, and execution of initiatives that reduce cost, improve service, and unlock scalable efficiency across the business.

This role partners cross-functionally with Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, Sales, Planning, and other key stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and deliver high-impact opportunities across the Operations expense base. The Senior Manager will own the Operations Efficiency project portfolio, ensuring initiatives are clearly defined, delivered on time, financially validated, and incorporated into forecast updates in partnership with Finance.

This is a highly visible, hands-on role for a strategic operator who can move seamlessly from executive-level portfolio management to deep analytical problem solving and cross-functional execution.

Other requirements:

  • Travel required (domestic & international) – up to 20%
  • Flexible work schedule to accommodate virtual meetings with other regions

What You'll Do

Own the Operations Efficiency Agenda

  • Lead the Operations Efficiency program across SharkNinja, serving as the central owner for cost savings, service improvement, and continuous improvement initiatives across the Operations expense base
  • Develop and manage the Operations Efficiency project portfolio, including opportunity identification, business case development, initiative prioritization, execution tracking, risk management, and benefits realization
  • Establish clear governance, routines, and reporting mechanisms to ensure initiatives remain on track, roadblocks are escalated quickly, and leaders have visibility to progress, savings, and risks
  • Act as a thought partner to Operations leadership by identifying where cost, service, process, or organizational improvements can unlock meaningful business value

Drive Cost Savings and Service Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to reduce Operations Expense while maintaining or improving service levels, customer experience, and operational reliability
  • Partner with Global Logistics to deeply understand distribution, transportation, delivery, warehousing, carrier, and network cost drivers
  • Lead cross-functional workstreams focused on improving cost-to-serve, delivery efficiency, network utilization, freight optimization, accessorial management, productivity, and service performance
  • Translate data and operational insights into actionable recommendations, business cases, and execution plans
  • Challenge existing ways of working and bring a continuous improvement mindset to how SharkNinja scales operations with speed, agility, and discipline

Partner Cross-Functionally to Deliver Results

  • Collaborate closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Sales, Planning, Consumer Experience, and other business partners to identify and execute opportunities
  • Build strong working relationships with Finance to ensure savings methodologies are aligned, benefits are validated, and impacts are reflected in forecast updates, budgets, and financial reporting
  • Create transparency across initiative owners, milestones, financial impacts, dependencies, and risks
  • Influence without authority across a fast-moving, matrixed organization, ensuring teams are aligned around common goals and accountable for delivery

Lead Continuous Improvement

  • Bring structured problem-solving, Lean, Six Sigma, or similar continuous improvement methods to complex operational challenges
  • Identify root causes of cost increases, service misses, process inefficiencies, and operational friction
  • Develop scalable processes, playbooks, and tools that improve how SharkNinja identifies, manages, and delivers efficiency opportunities
  • Create a culture of ownership, accountability, and speed in delivering operational improvements

What You'll Bring

The ideal candidate is a high-energy, analytical, commercially minded operator who thrives in a fast-paced environment — equally comfortable building an executive-ready savings roadmap, digging into logistics cost drivers, challenging assumptions, aligning Finance on benefit validation, and pushing cross-functional teams to deliver. This person brings a "CEO mindset" to Operations Expense: seeing the full picture, owning outcomes, making tradeoffs, driving accountability, and relentlessly pursuing better ways to deliver cost, service, and operational performance.

  • 7+ years of experience in Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Continuous Improvement, or a related field
  • Experience in consumer products, retail, eCommerce, durable goods, or high-growth global operations
  • Demonstrated experience leading cost reduction, operational efficiency, productivity, or transformation initiatives
  • Strong understanding of logistics, distribution, transportation, warehousing, delivery operations, and cost-to-serve drivers
  • Experience managing a portfolio of cross-functional initiatives with multiple owners, timelines, dependencies, and financial impacts
  • Proven ability to partner with Finance on savings validation, forecasting, budgeting, or financial performance tracking
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn complex data into clear insights, recommendations, and action plans
  • Experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders in a fast-paced, matrixed environment
  • Background in Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, process improvement, or operational excellence
  • Proficient in Microsoft Project, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio; experience with ERP/WMS/eCommerce platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Shopify, Salesforce Commerce Cloud) a plus

Education: An undergraduate degree from a respected college/university, ideally in a discipline relevant to supply chain (e.g., Supply Chain Management or Engineering). A Master's degree in Business Administration or a technical discipline is not required but will further differentiate the ideal candidate.

Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day.  Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

What We Offer

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.  

At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We support ALL associates in bringing their authentic selves to work, making an impact, and having the opportunity for career acceleration. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. title: Senior Partner Deployed Engineer
description: The Role We are looking for a Senior Partner Deployed Engineer to join the Customer Solutions team, focused on building Coder’s partner ecosystem across EMEA. This is a new function at Coder, modeled on the Forward Deployed Engineer role pioneered by companies like Palantir and now the fastest-growing technical role at frontier AI companies. The difference: instead of embedding with a single customer to deploy a platform, you embed with strategic partners to help them understand, position, and deliver Coder’s platform across their entire customer base. You are part Field CTO, part Industry Strategist, part Technical Specialist, and part Partner Relations Lead. You will be the technical authority within our EMEA partner ecosystem: setting the vision for how Coder fits into each partner’s AI, cloud, and modernization offerings, co-creating the GTM sales plays that partner sellers take to market, building the demonstrations and workshops that generate pipeline, and producing the Partner Relations content that establishes Coder’s technical brand in the ecosystem. This is not a support role. You are equally comfortable holding a strategic roadmap conversation with a partner CTO and debugging a Kubernetes deployment in a partner’s lab in the same afternoon. You are energized by the challenge of building a new category through partnerships, motivated by the multiplied impact of enabling an entire ecosystem rather than a single customer, and capable of operating with full autonomy in a fast-moving startup environment. What You’ll Do Serve as the strategic technical thought partner to EMEA partner leadership, including practice leads, CTOs, and solutions architects at global systems integrators, regional cloud consultancies, and hyperscaler field teams. Own the technical relationship and set the vision for how Coder fits into each partner’s AI and modernization portfolio. Co-create sales plays tailored to each partner’s customer base, vertical focus, and services capabilities. Author Working Backwards outcome proposals for strategic partner-customer combinations that translate AI Development Infrastructure into deal-level urgency. Develop and deliver workshops, Builder Labs, and partner-hosted enablement sessions as the primary awareness and demand generation vehicle for the EMEA ecosystem. Build hands-on demonstration environments and interactive experiences that partners can use independently. Intervene directly on the highest-value partner-attached deals across EMEA: co-sell calls, technical discovery, PoV scoping, architecture review, and technical win support. Own the engagement until the partner’s team can carry it independently. Transform bespoke partner enablement sessions into structured LMS modules and certification tiers that scale across the EMEA partner base without requiring live PDE support for each new partner. Produce “better together” reference architectures for strategic partner combinations across cloud providers and AI platforms. Include deployment diagrams, network topology, IAM patterns, and operational runbooks that partner SAs can hand directly to customers. Codify each successful partner engagement into a repeatable GTM play: trigger conditions, discovery questions, positioning framework, demo script, PoV scope template, and expected outcomes. Build a playbook library that a new PDE or partner seller can pick up and run. Build AI-powered self-service tools that automate high-volume PDE activities: Opportunity Brief Generator, PR/FAQ Generator, Workshop-in-a-Box deployment, and demo site builder. Produce a monthly partner intelligence digest from EMEA engagements: what customers are asking for, how competitors are positioning, where integrations are missing, which vertical use cases are emerging. Distribute to Product, Engineering, and GTM leadership. Own the EMEA-relevant portions of the joint technical integration roadmap with strategic partners. Define priorities cross-functionally with Product and Engineering based on field signals from the EMEA market. Create and publish Partner Relations content, the ecosystem equivalent of Developer Relations: technical blog posts, cookbooks, partner ecosystem conference talks, enablement videos, and workshop recaps. Build Coder’s technical brand within the EMEA partner community. Contribute to cloud marketplace product listing stewardship, competency maintenance documentation, and CSP co-build technical requirements as they apply to EMEA-specific partner and compliance contexts. What We’re Looking For 7+ years of experience in a combination of Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Field CTO, Technical Consulting, or Developer Relations roles at an infrastructure, developer tools, or AI company Demonstrated experience helping partners or customers understand and adopt products in emerging or undefined categories, not just executing playbooks for established ones Proven hands-on experience designing and deploying cloud infrastructure on at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure), with production-level Kubernetes and Terraform depth. You have done the work and can speak to it with specificity. 2+ years deploying or operating AI coding agents in a production or near-production environment: you understand how agent loops execute, where credentials live, and what governance and audit requirements look like in a European enterprise context Ability to articulate the architectural difference between workspace-local agent tooling and a centralized agentic harness, and to explain why that distinction matters to a security, compliance, or data sovereignty stakeholder Experience working with channel or technology partners in a co-sell model: hyperscaler partner programs, GSI/RSI partnerships, or VAR/distributor ecosystems in EMEA markets Experience building repeatable technical GTM assets that scaled beyond your personal delivery: sales plays, enablement curricula, reference architectures, or technical content programs Executive communication and Field CTO credibility: you can hold a technical vision conversation with a partner CTO and a deal-level architecture review with an SE in the same day, in English and ideally at least one additional European language Strong written communication: you can produce a Working Backwards PR/FAQ, a technical architecture document, and a blog post without those being separate skills requiring separate people Self-directed, analytically minded, and comfortable operating with full autonomy. You will define processes that don’t exist, build tools that haven’t been scoped, and create a function from first principles in a new region. Bonus Points (Bonus tacos? That’s how we say thanks at Coder. Ask us about it.) Prior Forward Deployed Engineer experience at a platform company (Palantir, Scale AI, frontier AI lab, or equivalent embedded deployment model) Track record of public technical advocacy: blog posts, conference talks, open-source contributions, or developer/partner community engagement Experience with hyperscaler partner programs (e.g., ISV Accelerate, strategic collaboration agreements, co-sell programs) at an operational level Familiarity with European regulatory environments: GDPR, DORA, NIS2, AI Act compliance requirements, and data sovereignty patterns for cloud-native deployments Experience with air-gapped or network-isolated deployments common in European financial services, government, or defense contexts Background in AI governance frameworks, session audit requirements, or SIEM integration for AI workloads Experience with LLM gateway or proxy infrastructure (LiteLLM, OpenRouter, or equivalent) in a multi-team or enterprise context Experience designing human-in-the-loop breakpoints or escalation patterns for autonomous agent workflows Kubernetes certification (CKA, CKAD, or CKS) Experience with Tailscale or similar overlay networking tools Open-source contributions, particularly in CNCF, MCP, or AI agent ecosystems Existing relationships with hyperscaler EMEA solutions architecture teams, European GSI technical practices, or AI infrastructure partner ecosystems Fluency in German, French, or a Nordic language in addition to English What Success Looks Like You have done the hard technical work before: deploying cloud-native infrastructure, navigating Kubernetes in production, building with Terraform, and operating in the complexity of large European enterprise environments. You bring that credibility into every partner conversation. You can walk a partner CTO through how Coder enables parallelized AI agents in a regulated European enterprise, covering credential isolation, audit lineage, GDPR-compliant data handling, and escalation design, and turn that conversation into a joint GTM play their sellers can run next quarter. You can walk into an unstructured partner relationship, assess the technical and commercial opportunity, and chart a path from first enablement session to first co-sourced deal without waiting to be told what to do. You translate deep technical knowledge into assets that scale: reference architectures partners hand to their customers, enablement modules partners consume on their own, and GTM playbooks partner sellers run without PDE involvement. You are as invested in the pattern behind the engagement as you are in the engagement itself. Every bespoke partner interaction produces a reusable artifact. Every field insight feeds back to product. You codify by instinct. You make the ecosystem and the product better: your field experience shapes how Coder builds integrations, how partners deliver, and how the EMEA market understands AI Development Infrastructure as a category. Location: Remote EMEA (UK preferred) Department: Customer Solutions Reports to: Sr Manager, Solutions Engineering About Coder Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com . Interview process We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow. Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders. title: Project Engineer
description: Project Engineer Wil jij technische projecten van begin tot eind begeleiden? Krijg jij energie van het organiseren van complexe technische projecten en vind je het leuk om verschillende partijen met elkaar te verbinden? En wil je werken aan innovatieve oplossingen op het gebied van energieopslag en vermogenselektronica? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Wat ga je doen? Als Project Engineer begeleid je projecten binnen AEP Hybrid Power vanaf de technische overdracht na opdracht tot en met de oplevering. Jij bent de verbindende schakel tussen de klant, engineering, productiepartners, leveranciers en service. Je zorgt ervoor dat technische eisen, planning, budget, documentatie en testen goed op elkaar aansluiten. Je houdt overzicht, signaleert mogelijke problemen op tijd en zorgt ervoor dat acties en afspraken worden opgevolgd. Je taken omvatten onder andere: • Overnemen en structureren van projecten na opdracht, inclusief scope, specificaties, planning, budget en risico’s • Vertalen van klant- en contracteisen naar duidelijke technische specificaties en werkpakketten • Opstellen en bewaken van projectplanningen, actielijsten, mijlpalen en technische opleverpunten • Coördineren van engineering, inkoop, productie, testen en documentatie met interne en externe partners • Afstemmen van verschillende technische interfaces, zoals converters, ultracapacitorsystemen, besturingen, koeling en beveiligingen • Organiseren en begeleiden van technische project overleggen en design reviews met klanten en leveranciers • Bewaken van wijzigingen, technische risico’s, kosten en gevolgen voor de planning • Voorbereiden en begeleiden van functionele tests, FAT, SAT en commissioning • Zorgen voor complete projectdocumentatie, zoals tekeningen, datasheets, handleidingen, testprotocollen en opleverdossiers • Fungeren als technisch aanspreekpunt voor klanten en partners tijdens de uitvoering van het project • Evalueren van afgeronde projecten en verbeteringen aandragen voor onze producten en processen Kortom: jij zorgt ervoor dat een technisch project van opdracht tot oplevering goed georganiseerd en beheerst verloopt. Wie zijn wij? Binnen AEP zijn we actief in verschillende technische markten, waaronder hybride energie. Met AEP Hybrid Power richten we ons op innovatieve oplossingen op het gebied van energieopslag en vermogenselektronica. In jouw rol werk je aan projecten waarin verschillende technische disciplines samenkomen. Denk aan converters, ultracapacitors, besturingstechniek, elektrische installaties en energieopslag. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van engineering, productie, sales en service, maar hebt ook regelmatig contact met klanten, leveranciers en productiepartners. Hierdoor ben je betrokken bij het volledige traject van een project en zie je jouw werk uiteindelijk letterlijk in de praktijk terug. Wat vragen we jou? • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in Elektrotechniek, Energietechniek, Mechatronica, of vergelijkbaar • Kennis van vermogenselektronica, elektrische installaties, DC-systemen, AC-netten en/of energieopslag is een sterke pré • Ervaring met technisch projectmanagement, engineeringprojecten of commissioning is gewenst • Enkele jaren relevante werkervaring is mooi meegenomen. Ben je een sterke starter met passende stages of projecten? Ook dan komen we graag met je in gesprek • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Duits is een pré • Je vindt het leuk om incidenteel klanten en productiepartners in binnen- en buitenland te bezoeken • Je bent gestructureerd, planmatig en houdt goed overzicht • Je bent technisch analytisch en weet complexe vraagstukken te vertalen naar duidelijke acties • Je bent communicatief sterk en weet verschillende partijen op een prettige manier met elkaar te verbinden • Je bent proactief, oplossingsgericht en wacht niet af wanneer er actie nodig is Wat kan jij van ons verwachten? Binnen AEP kom je terecht in een technische en groeiende organisatie waar je veel ruimte krijgt voor eigen inbreng. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om mee te werken aan innovatieve projecten binnen de energietechniek en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Verder kan je het volgende van ons verwachten: • Een salaris tussen €3000 - €5000, o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring • Een veelzijdige technische functie met veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng • Werken aan innovatieve oplossingen binnen de energietechniek • Ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling • Een functie waarin je zowel op kantoor, in onze testomgeving als bij klanten werkt • Laptop en telefoon van de zaak • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en een goede pensioenregeling • Een verzorgde lunch wanneer je op kantoor bent • Een gezellig en technisch team met korte communicatielijnen Interesse?
