raw.jobDescription:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

AI is moving faster than any single product team can track. Nebius is expanding across serverless, databases, MLflow, MLOps, Physical AI, and HCLS — and customers arriving with complex, real-world ML workloads need more than documentation. This role exists to close that gap: someone who can prototype what's possible, accelerate customers through their first 90 days, and feed hard-won field insight back into the product roadmap.
This role sits at the intersection of deep ML engineering and product impact. You'll spend roughly half your time in the field — helping new customers move from POC to production, running technical onboarding, and working hands-on through their ML stack. The other half you'll spend building — prototyping applied AI use cases that show what's possible on the platform, going deep on emerging techniques before they're mainstream, and turning that expertise into concrete product direction.
This is not a presales role. You get your hands dirty every day.

What success looks like in 12 months

  • The product and sales teams have a library of working, polished demos they reach for on calls
  • Enterprise customers you've touched have meaningfully faster time-to-value than those you haven't
  • At least 2–3 product changes were shipped because of feedback you originated
  • The team understands where applied AI is heading 6–12 months from now, partly because you told them

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Build prototypes and demos across the product portfolio — serverless inference, databases, MLflow, MLOps, and vertical use cases in Physical AI and HCLS — that become assets for sales, product, and engineering teams
  • Support new customers hands-on through POC design, technical onboarding, and validation; act as the bridge between their ML team and the platform during the critical first months
  • Go deep on emerging applied AI — new training techniques, inference optimizations, agentic architectures, new frameworks — and turn findings into working prototypes, writeups, and product recommendations
  • Feed the product roadmap with specific, grounded feedback; be the voice of "here's what broke in three customer POCs last month and here's what needs to change"
  • Develop reusable technical assets — notebooks, reference architectures, benchmark results — that reduce onboarding friction at scale

We expect you to have:

  • You've fine-tuned large models, debugged distributed training jobs, built production RAG or agentic pipelines, and optimized inference on GPU infrastructure — not just read about it
  • You're fluent in the modern ML stack: PyTorch, HuggingFace, CUDA fundamentals, Kubernetes for ML, MLflow or equivalent, vector databases
  • You've worked with enterprise ML teams — whether as a solutions engineer, customer engineer, or an ML engineer who collaborated closely with customers
  • You read papers and implement them — not for credit, but because it's how you stay sharp
  • You communicate with calibration: you can explain activation checkpointing tradeoffs to an ML engineer in the morning and the cost implication to a CTO in the afternoon

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience in any of our vertical domains: Physical AI / robotics / simulation, HCLS (drug discovery, medical imaging, clinical NLP), or enterprise AI application development
  • Familiarity with MLOps at scale (Kubeflow, Metaflow, Argo, Ray)
  • Prior work at a cloud provider or AI infrastructure company
  • You've shared technical work publicly — notebooks, talks, blog posts that people actually use

Who thrives here

You'll thrive here if you're energized by variety — one day deep in a customer's MLOps stack, the next building a demo from scratch. You want your technical depth to influence product decisions, not just close deals.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional growth within Nebius.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • A dynamic and collaborative work environment that values initiative and innovation.

We're growing and expanding our products every day. If you're up to the challenge and are excited about AI and ML as much as we are, join us!

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

Base Compensation Range

$200—$350,000 USD

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

title: Engineering Manager
description: About Tekmetric Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better. Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably. Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset. But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time. Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair. Working the Tekmetric Way At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together. We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here. We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders. Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you. Where We Work : At Tekmetric, great work happens anywhere, but great teams are built through intentional connection. We offer hybrid and remote work models based on your proximity to our office hubs. Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported. What You’ll Do As an Engineering Manager, you'll be responsible for leading a team of engineers in the design, development, and implementation of our products. You'll play a key role in guiding the technical direction of our projects, ensuring the highest quality of engineering work, and supporting the professional growth of your team members. Lead and mentor a team of engineers, providing technical guidance and career development support Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment Own your team’s delivery, quality and timely execution Guide key technical decisions around new product initiatives Work closely with other departments, including product, design, and QA, to align engineering activities with company objectives Continuously evaluate and improve engineering processes and practices to enhance team efficiency and product quality Assist in recruiting, onboarding, and training new engineering team members What You’ll Bring 7+ years in software development with at least 2 years of engineering leadership experience You have built and developed an impactful team of passionate engineers You are able to tackle sophisticated engineering problems that deliver results which help the team to achieve its objectives You’re passionate about being in a product-focused environment where everyone cares deeply about customer impact Why You'll Love Working With Us Health & Wellness That Have You Covered: Enjoy the flexibility of remote work Competitive base salaries that reflect your value. Flexible PTO — No set number of days, just the trust to take the time you need. We genuinely encourage our team to disconnect and recharge. Support for every stage of life—with paid maternity, parental bonding, and medical leave for you or your loved ones. Comprehensive health benefits, including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Prescription coverage. For employee only, we offer plans that cover 100% of premiums and we cover 50% of costs for families. Prioritizing your mental health: get free, confidential counseling through our partnership with BetterHelp. Investing in Your Future (and Present): 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with 100% employer match on contributions up to 6% - so your future self will thank you. Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) to make your money go further. Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance for added peace of mind. Wellness on your terms: get up to $60/month toward fitness, mental health, or almost anything that helps you feel your best. After one year of employment, enjoy a $300 home office setup bonus to help make your space work for you. Keep growing with support for continuing education - we’re invested in your development. Most importantly, we have a stellar team, a whole lot of fun, and work that actually matters to the shops and families we serve! Tekmetric is an equal opportunity employer. We hire hard-working individuals, regardless of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative and successful. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. Tekmetric will never ask for your personal financial or banking information or require any financial commitment as part of our candidate search or application process. title: Engineering Manager
description: At NetBox Labs , our mission is to make it easier to build and manage complex networks. As a product company, we do that by developing innovative software for network professionals delivered on-premises and in the cloud. We believe in the power of community and collaboration, and we are looking for a hands-on, player-coach Engineering Manager to lead one of our talented teams. These teams build our core software applications including NetBox and NetBox Add-ons, SDKs, and Plugins, and our observability suite including Diode, Diode Agents and SDKs, and Orb. Much of this development is open source and done in collaboration with our community, but also spans source-available and proprietary software. This role reports to the Director of Engineering. In this role you will: Lead a squad of engineers day-to-day while staying hands-on: reviewing code, jumping into design discussions, and occasionally shipping code yourself to unblock the team or model best practices. Drive execution relentlessly — break down ambiguous problems into clear plans, set sprint goals, remove blockers fast, and hold the team accountable to deadlines. Own the software development lifecycle for your team's projects, from planning and design through implementation, testing, and release. Run effective sprint planning, stand-ups, and retros using GitHub and internal tools, helping engineers break work into well-scoped, executable pieces. Champion modern, secure software development practices and keep quality bars high without slowing the team down. Partner closely with product managers to translate customer and community problems into shippable plans, pushing back with data when scope or timelines don't add up. Coach and mentor engineers individually — give direct, timely feedback, help them grow technically, and build a strong bench for future hiring. Foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the team. Act as a liaison between your team and the broader tech community, supporting open-source contributors and guiding community-facing initiatives where relevant. Report progress transparently to engineering leadership, flagging risks early rather than after they've become problems. Stay close enough to the code and the architecture to make credible calls on technical trade-offs, while trusting your engineers to own the details of implementation. You will work closely with: Director of Engineering to coordinate cross-functional initiatives and ensure your team's work runs smoothly in our commercial products. Product team to understand customer and community problems and turn them into a stellar user experience. Peer engineering managers to plan cross-functional projects, clarify ownership, surface dependencies, and clear blockers together. Qualifications: 2+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager or Team Lead, ideally in a player-coach capacity where you're still writing code or reviewing PRs regularly. A track record of driving projects to completion on tight timelines, with a strong bias toward action and unblocking your team over process for its own sake. Strong technical background sufficient to review designs and code, and earn credibility with senior engineers. Experience with Agile methodologies, DevOps, and CI/CD in a fast-moving environment. Proficiency with GitHub for code management, project tracking, and collaboration. Solid understanding of software security principles and practices. Experience with open-source software development and community engagement is a plus. Excellent, direct communication skills — comfortable giving and receiving fast feedback in a remote, async-first environment. Proven ability to coach engineers and help them grow, while still being the person who rolls up their sleeves when the team needs it. It would be fantastic if you have the following background: Networking industry experience. Familiarity with Python, Django, Go, gRPC, or OpenTelemetry. Knowledge of cloud platforms and services (e.g., AWS, Azure). Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). Understanding of data privacy regulations and compliance requirements. About NetBox Labs: NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community. NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox. NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital. Our culture and values: We own and solve problems with high attention to detail. Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win. We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly. NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

About the Role

DocV Solution Engineering is part of the Product Engineering organization and plays a critical role in accelerating customer adoption, enabling the field, and improving system reliability. We are seeking a Senior Manager to lead the DocV Solution Engineering team and partner closely with Customer Success, Commercial, Product, and Engineering teams.

This role focuses on short-term, high-impact technical work that enables revenue, accelerates rollout of new DocV features, and improves platform stability—while core backend and frontend teams remain focused on long-term product roadmap delivery.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and lead a Solution Engineering team embedded within Product Engineering.

  • Partner closely with Customer Success and Commercial teams to unblock implementations and accelerate customer outcomes.

  • Deliver short-term technical initiatives that enable field teams and support active customer engagements.

  • Collaborate directly with customers on complex DocV integrations and deployment challenges.

  • Develop targeted features, prototypes, and integrations that accelerate adoption of new DocV capabilities.

  • Identify and address integration-related technical debt to improve reliability, stability, and operational robustness.

  • Establish a strong feedback loop between customers, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams.

  • Collaborate with Backend and Frontend teams to transition validated solutions into the core product roadmap where appropriate.

  • Anticipate recurring customer and field needs and drive scalable, repeatable solutions.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting experience.

  • At least 3 years of experience leading customer-facing or hybrid engineering teams.

  • Strong understanding of APIs, SDKs, and enterprise integration patterns.

  • Ability to deliver production-quality solutions in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

  • Strong communication skills and experience working across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly.

title: Chief Technology Officer - US-Based
description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce . We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Position Description: As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it. You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down. You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence. You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency. Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards. You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal. This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the details. This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction. AI and agentic engineering Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against. Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for. Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed. Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you. Team, resourcing, and accountability Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product. Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments. Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows. Platform and execution Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows. Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend. In the first week, expect to: Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services. Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO. In the first month, expect to: Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down. Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for. In the first three months, expect to: Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented. Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result. In the first six months, expect to: Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it. Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most. In the first year, expect to: Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering. Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred. 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale. Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up. Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work. Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence. Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers. Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for. You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI. Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar. Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale. Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield. Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do. Essential Job Functions Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera. Work independently with minimal supervision. Use all required digital collaboration tools. Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines. US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt Compensation Additional Information

title: Chief Architect
description: Chief Architect Remote - US Legion Technologies is building the AI-powered operating system for the hourly workforce. We are hiring a Chief Architect to serve as Legion’s most senior hands-on technical leader and to shape the technical foundation that will power the next decade of product innovation. This is not a strategy-only or advisory role. The Chief Architect must live close to the code, go deep with engineering teams, challenge assumptions, write and review technical designs, make high-consequence architecture decisions, and help turn bold product ambitions into scalable, reliable production systems. This person will own architecture and technical decision-making for the most complex parts of Legion’s Workforce Management platform, including AI, optimization, forecasting, scheduling, distributed systems, data platforms, real-time decisioning, enterprise scalability, security, compliance, and developer productivity. The ideal candidate has built and scaled mission-critical software used by large enterprise customers, has deep technical credibility with senior engineers, and can operate fluidly between code-level decisions and long-term platform strategy. They are pragmatic, decisive, opinionated, and comfortable making hard tradeoffs when simplicity, scalability, reliability, or customer trust require it. This role reports to the Head of Product, Engineering, and Support. This is an open role currently being filled on an interim basis by the CEO. Responsibilities and Duties Hands-On Architecture and Technical Decision-Making Serve as Legion’s senior-most hands-on technical authority for complex architecture, system design, and platform evolution. Personally dive into code, design documents, production incidents, performance bottlenecks, and implementation tradeoffs to diagnose root causes and guide technical direction. Lead the hardest technical decisions across AI systems, optimization engines, distributed systems, data architecture, reliability, scalability, security, and platform modernization. Write prototypes, reference implementations, architecture decision records, technical specifications, and design patterns where needed to unblock teams and establish clear direction. Make high-consequence technical decisions with incomplete information, balancing correctness, simplicity, speed, scalability, reliability, cost, and long-term maintainability. Challenge architectural drift, unnecessary complexity, weak abstractions, and short-term decisions that create long-term platform risk. Partner directly with Staff, Principal, and senior engineering leaders in design reviews, code-level discussions, and implementation planning. This person will own architecture and technical decision-making for the most complex parts of Legion’s Workforce Management platform, including AI, optimization, forecasting, scheduling, distributed systems, data platforms, real-time decisioning, enterprise scalability, security, compliance, and developer productivity.

The ideal candidate has built and scaled mission-critical software used by large enterprise customers, has deep technical credibility with senior engineers, and can operate fluidly between code-level decisions and long-term platform strategy. They are pragmatic, decisive, opinionated, and comfortable making hard tradeoffs when simplicity, scalability, reliability, or customer trust require it.

This role reports to the Head of Product, Engineering, and Support. This is an open role currently being filled on an interim basis by the CEO.

Responsibilities and Duties

Hands-On Architecture and Technical Decision-Making

  • Partner directly with Staff, Principal, and senior engineering leaders in design reviews, code-level discussions, and implementation planning.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on. The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running. Tala is seeking a driven engineer to join our growing Product Development team. The ideal candidate is adept at problem-solving and debugging, and is committed to continuously improving existing systems and processes. You will work closely with fellow Tala engineers to build and extend Tala's backend architecture to support new country launches, new features, and a fast growing user base. The Senior Backend Engineer owns systems and initiatives that span a domain. You set your own technical approach, need minimal technical guidance, and raise the domain's quality bar through design, review, and partnership with peers. As a technologist and a leader, you push the team toward a highly available, scalable, reliable, fault tolerant, and performant microservices platform. You follow and improve Tala's engineering processes and standards while advancing Tala's mission and business objectives. This is a technical leadership role within Tala's technical track, set in a supportive team environment with significant opportunities for career advancement and professional development. You will collaborate cross-functionally with teams across the globe. Key Responsibilities Design and Engineering Design, develop, and maintain backend services, APIs, and data integration layers that power key product features. Author design documents (EDDs) for services in the domain and defend them in review. Design and optimize database schemas and queries for performance and system reliability. Meet project goals without trading away quality, and pay down technical debt as part of delivery rather than as a separate request. Serve as the go-to person for one or more technologies in the domain, following industry developments and explaining concretely how they would or would not apply at Tala. Quality, Review, and Standards Hold the domain's engineering bar in code and design reviews, including for work from other technical teams. Write clean, maintainable code that follows established coding standards. Contribute to the testing infrastructure to increase coverage for backend modules. Verify AI-assisted changes to the same standard as hand-written code. Reliability and Operations Define alerting, SLIs, and SLOs, and advance monitoring of backend modules so availability and response times improve proactively. Handle incidents that the runbook does not cover, fill runbook gaps found during a shift, lead the technical response for domain incidents, and write the RCA. description: At Veracyte , we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Rather than functioning as a traditional QA organization, the Quality Engineering Platform team partners with Software Engineering, Product Management, CloudOps, Data & AI, Laboratory Operations, and DevOps to build quality into every stage of the software development lifecycle. The team develops reusable automation platforms, testing infrastructure, quality metrics, and AI-enabled engineering capabilities that allow product teams to continuously validate cloud-native applications, APIs, enterprise integrations, laboratory workflows, and AI-powered solutions. As the Manager, Software Test Automation you will define Veracyte's quality engineering strategy, establish modern engineering practices, and lead a team of Software Development Engineers in Test (SDETs), Automation Engineers, and Quality Platform Engineers responsible for enabling engineering excellence across the organization. Evaluate and adopt emerging AI technologies that improve engineering productivity and software quality. Coach engineering teams on automation strategies, testing best practices, and quality ownership. Provide consulting, tooling, and technical guidance that enables product teams to deliver software with confidence. Partner with DevOps and CloudOps to integrate quality engineering into modern CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native delivery platforms. Operational Excellence Establish engineering metrics that measure software quality, automation effectiveness, developer productivity, release confidence, platform adoption, and customer impact. Drive observability, defect prevention, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure software validation activities support regulatory requirements applicable to healthcare diagnostics, including HIPAA, CAP/CLIA, and FDA software quality expectations where appropriate. Who You Are: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 6 – 7 years of software engineering, quality engineering, or software development experience. 3+ years leading Quality Engineering, Test Engineering, SDET, or Developer Platform engineering teams. Proven experience building engineering platforms that improve software quality and developer productivity. Strong background developing automated testing frameworks for cloud-native applications and distributed systems. Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices. Experience building internal developer platforms, engineering tooling, or self-service engineering capabilities. Strong understanding of AWS cloud technologies, APIs, distributed systems, and modern software architecture. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, organizational, and people leadership skills. Preferred Qualifications: Experience in healthcare, diagnostics, laboratory information systems (LIS/LIMS), molecular diagnostics, or regulated medical software. Experience validating healthcare interoperability standards including HL7, FHIR, X12, and related healthcare transactions. Experience testing AI-enabled products, machine learning systems, or generative AI applications. Experience using AI-assisted development and testing tools to improve engineering productivity. Experience with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, REST Assured, Karate, Postman, JUnit, TestNG, or similar automation technologies. Experience building automation using Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or C#. Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud-native platforms. Experience implementing performance engineering, security testing, chaos engineering, or site reliability engineering practices. Experience working within regulated environments including HIPAA, FDA, CAP/CLIA, ISO 13485, or SOC 2. AWS certifications or software testing certifications are a plus. We empower clinicians with the high-value insights they need to guide and assure patients at pivotal moments in the race to diagnose and treat cancer. You will have a proven track record of supporting, mentoring, leading and growing a development team, and of delivering high-scale cloud-based software systems. You will enjoy problem-solving and removing blockers to the team’s progress, and will have experience collaborating with Product teams and customer stakeholders. You will be an effective and clear communicator who can direction-set and track team delivery in a distributed, fast-moving and rapidly-changing agile environment. For this role, you should be located in Canada , and able to work within EST/EDT hours. We offer a choice of fully remote, partially remote or fully office-based work environments (in cities with local offices). What you’ll be responsible for : Guiding, motivating and growing a team of software developers as they solve complex problems in the Financial Services domain Directly and indirectly managing a team through collaboration with, and mentorship of a Technical Lead Staff Engineer Working closely with architects, Product teams, engineering leadership and stakeholders to align on team priorities and roadmaps Identifying, communicating and removing impediments and risks to delivery, within the team and across Financial Services as a whole Planning and furthering the professional growth of individual team members, including 1-1s, performance reviews, ongoing feedback, goal-setting and promotions Reporting up to engineering leadership and stakeholders on team progress and status Finding and hiring top talent for your team and the wider organization Providing technical and process guidance to the team during delivery What you’ll be bringing to the team: Experience leading a team of developers through successful delivery of software products Experience delivering microservice-driven, scalable, cloud-based applications Strong working knowledge of Java or TypeScript or Ruby or Python Professional experience in agile development and continuous delivery best practices Strong written and verbal English communication skills Ability to personally coach, mentor and drive individuals and overall teams Strong passion for continuous learning and improvement A quality-driven mindset with a focus on software scalability and resilience Some additional things that would be a bonus : Experience in the Payments domain Experience in building scalable SaaS solutions Experience in full-stack web application development Solid knowledge of cloud services (AWS and GCP in particular) Project Management or Scrum master experience, or formal training Experience in test automation and/or DevOps engineering Who you are: A leader with strong people skills who can manage and represent your team A teacher and mentor helping individuals to grow and reach their full potential A communicator who can clearly convey requirements, best practices and status updates to both technical and non-technical audiences A problem-solver who embraces tackling complexity and removing roadblocks A decisive decision-maker who can handle change and ambiguity What is in for you Lots of autonomy, flexible work culture and possibility of remote work Opportunity to help shape the future of a new Product from technical, process and organizational perspectives Development of global products Exposure to modern and proven technology Opportunity to learn and expand your skill set Tons of growth opportunities into technical or people management roles Amazing benefits & perks, including equity for all Lightspeeders Opportunity to join a fast-paced, high-growth company Become a valued part of the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed family #LI-SS3 At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. Lightspeed also provides a variety of employee benefits including, but not limited to, medical, dental, wellness, life and disability insurance, RRSP plan and match, paid parental leave top-up, and paid time off. Please note that this compensation information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within Ontario and reflects the amount Lightspeed is willing to pay at the time of this posting. This role represents an existing vacancy at Lightspeed. Lightspeed uses artificial intelligence–enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process; all hiring decisions are made by our recruiting and hiring teams. To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here . Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs. Who we are: Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries. Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement .

Who you are:

#LI-SS3

At Lightspeed, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your skill set, qualifications, experience, and market data.   • A security certification such as CISSP or CISM
  • Experience leading the security function at a late-stage startup, scale-up, or public company
  • Working depth in healthcare data protection and privacy frameworks, including HIPAA, GDPR, and CCPA/CPRA
  • Experience overseeing enterprise frameworks and audits such as SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS, and ISO 27001
  • Strong knowledge of application, network, and cloud security (AWS and Azure) and frameworks such as NIST CSF and OWASP
  • Experience running core security programs, including incident response, risk management, vulnerability management, penetration testing, and security awareness
  • Executive-level communication skills and confidence engaging customers and sales teams on security requirements
  • Experience managing budget and allocating resources across people, tools, and vendors

 

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience leading security through a major company event such as an IPO, acquisition, or large-scale audit cycle
  • A background in healthcare, digital health, or another highly regulated, high-trust environment
  • Experience leading security in a remote-first, globally distributed company
  • Familiarity with compliance automation platforms such as Drata
  • Experience building a security engineering practice alongside platform and infrastructure teams

 

Why This Role Matters

Members trust Carrot with some of the most personal information a person can share, often during some of the most meaningful moments of their lives. Protecting that trust is not a back-office function. It is what allows employers, health plans, and health systems to bring Carrot to millions of people worldwide.

As Carrot grows, security leadership shapes how we build, how we sell, and how we show up for customers. In this role, you will make security a strength that members and customers can see and rely on, and build a team that keeps raising the bar as the business scales.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

 

Compensation: 

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their lives inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $188,000.00 - $245,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

What you'll do

There is no MSSP and no tier-1 queue here. Detection & Response engineers own their detections end to end: you write them, you tune them, and your team is paged when they fire. The security team is spread across the globe with a follow-the-sun pager rotation so nobody is paged at 3am local.

The adversaries are real. The business is growing fast and the threat surface is growing with it. Defining the necessary telemetry is part of the job.

Detection engineering

  • Build and tune detections across endpoint, identity, SaaS, and cloud, treating them as software: version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and shipped through the same CI/CD practices the rest of engineering uses.
  • Track detection quality as measured quantities: coverage against MITRE ATT&CK, precision, time-to-detect. We don’t build-and-forget here.

Response & automation

  • Own incident response: triage, contain, remediate, and write the retrospective that turns the incident into a systemic fix.
  • Build automation that removes toil from investigations, and partner closely with the US-based team so context carries across time zones instead of getting lost at handoff.

Telemetry & partnership

  • Define telemetry requirements for new systems before they ship, working with infrastructure and product teams to close visibility gaps rather than discovering them during an incident.
  • Threat hunt proactively across the estate, converting hypotheses into either new detections or documented coverage.

You Should Have

  • Typically 5–8 years of experience in detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting, with real hands-on time writing and tuning detections. We care more about what you've built than the exact number.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, or similar) and comfort writing production-grade detection and automation code.
  • Experience with a modern SIEM or detection pipeline (Panther, Elastic, Splunk, or similar). What matters is that you've shipped and tuned detection logic in production.
  • Practical incident response experience: you've led or played a major role in triaging and closing out real security incidents.

Nice to have

  • Experience treating detections as code with CI/CD, peer review, and staged rollout.
  • Experience defining telemetry contracts for systems before they ship, rather than retrofitting logging after an incident.
  • A track record of critically evaluating and verifying AI-assisted work - testing, source-checking, validation - rather than trusting agent output by default. If you haven’t already spotted the em dashes in this job description and already thought about where the hiring manager (hi!) has put hands on keyboard and compared that to where they let the LLM watermarks through, you might not be the right person for the job.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native and Kubernetes telemetry.
  • Experience with fraud or financial-crime detection patterns.

How we work

  • We stay closely aligned with teammates on other continents via Slack, video, and async docs.
  • We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one.
  • We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best.

Why this role is special

  • You own your detections end to end, no MSSP, no tier-1 queue, no handing your work to someone else to triage.
  • The consequences here are physical, not abstract: a containment decision can stop a customs filing or freight actually moving, which makes the stakes concrete in a way a SaaS control plane rarely is.

raw.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
raw.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

title: Graduate Transport Planner
description:
At Curtins, we're an employee-owned engineering consultancy driven by a simple ambition: to create a better built environment for everyone.

For over 65 years, we've delivered practical, innovative and sustainable solutions that make a positive impact on communities across the UK and Ireland. From major regeneration schemes and commercial developments to education, healthcare and residential projects, our work helps shape the places where people live, learn, work and thrive.

As a Graduate Transport Planner, you'll work alongside experienced planners, engineers and consultants, contributing to a wide range of projects while developing the technical and professional skills you need to build your career.

Whether you're interested in transport assessments, active travel & sustainable mobility, highways or public transport, we'll give you the experience, guidance and support to find the areas that interest you most and develop your expertise in development planning.

What you'll be doing

You will support the planning and development process, helping clients bring projects forward from initial concept through to planning approval.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Assisting with the preparation of Transport Assessments and Transport Statements.

  • Supporting the production of Travel Plans and technical planning reports.

  • Analysing traffic, transport and movement data.

  • Assisting with junction assessments and development impact studies.

  • Supporting planning applications for residential, commercial and mixed-use developments.

  • Working alongside planners, civil engineers and other specialists to deliver integrated solutions.

  • Attending client meetings, project discussions and stakeholder consultations.

  • Taking part in wider Curtins activities including STEM outreach, charity initiatives and community projects.

What kind of projects will I get to work on?

You'll be involved in projects across a wide range of sectors, including:

  • Residential developments.

  • Urban regeneration schemes.

  • Commercial and industrial projects.

  • Education and healthcare developments.

  • Mixed-use masterplans.

  • Strategic land and development opportunities.

You'll help assess how developments interact with the transport network and support clients through the planning process, helping turn ideas into deliverable projects.

How will Curtins support my development?

Our goal is simple: to help you become the best engineer you can be.

Through the Curtins Graduate Academy, you'll follow a structured development programme designed to accelerate both your technical and professional growth.

You'll benefit from:

  • A structured graduate development programme.

  • Dedicated mentoring and coaching.

  • Regular technical and professional skills training.

  • Support towards professional registration and Chartership.

  • Exposure to a wide range of projects, clients and sectors.

  • Opportunities to build your network across the business.

You'll be supported by experienced professionals who are genuinely invested in your success and development.

What we're looking for

We're looking for graduates who are curious, analytical and interested in how development projects are planned and delivered.

You'll ideally be studying towards or have recently completed a degree in:

  • Transport Planning

  • Geography

  • Urban Planning

  • Civil Engineering

  • Town Planning

  • Geography or a related discipline

It would also be advantageous to hold an MSc in Transport Planning, Transport Engineering, Urban Planning, or Development Planning.

Most importantly, we're looking for people who share our values:

Integrity - Doing the right thing.

Being Human - Supporting and respecting others.

Curiosity - Asking questions and seeking better solutions.

Impact - Making a meaningful difference through our work.

Why join Curtins?

As an employee-owned business, every person at Curtins contributes to and benefits from our success.

Alongside exciting projects and a supportive culture, you'll enjoy:

  • Industry-leading benefits package.

  • Award-winning training and development programmes.

  • Employee ownership benefits.

  • Opportunities to get involved in STEM, charity and community initiatives.

  • Access to our unique Employee Extras, including our 5-star holiday lodges.

Most importantly, you'll be joining a business where your ideas matter, your development is supported and your contribution makes a real difference.

Build your future with Curtins.

Should you wish to discuss any adjustments to the application process or provide us with feedback please contact hr@curtins.com we would be happy to discuss ways we can make the process more suitable to your needs.

We value diversity and respect all differences in people. We invite enthusiastic individuals who share in our values of teamwork, client focus, integrity, and quality to apply to join us.

When a new technique drops, your first instinct is to ask which Microsoft signal would catch it, and whether customers have it switched on.

You also know Microsoft never sits still. Hunting tables appear, columns get renamed, Graph versions retire, capability shuffles between SKUs, previews go GA, features quietly vanish, and native alert logic shifts underneath you. You've got a repeatable way of staying ahead of that churn instead of finding out when a detection stops firing. You're comfortable behind a command line and in front of a customer, including scenarios where the conversation isn’t pleasant. If that's you, we'd love to talk! We have an amazing team and believe you'll love getting to know us.

At Expel, we help businesses bridge the cybersecurity talent gap by providing transparent Managed Detection and Response. To do this we build technology to make sure our security analysts are solving important problems, and automation is helping them make better decisions at every step. We delight in using technology to make security accessible for our customers.

What Expel can do for you

  • Make you one of our recognized authorities on Microsoft detection and response — for our SOC, our engineers, our go-to-market teams, and our customers
  • Give you real ownership of Expel's detection coverage across the whole Microsoft security estate
  • Put Microsoft telemetry from across our customer base in front of you — a breadth of real-world environments no single enterprise gets to see

  • Provide access to popular EDR, network, SIEM, identity, and cloud technologies well beyond the Microsoft stack
  • Challenge you to push the boundaries of our security vision

What you can do for Expel

  • Own our detection coverage across Defender XDR, Entra ID, Sentinel, Microsoft Graph, Azure, and Microsoft 365 — from raw signal through to shipped, tuned detections
  • Build and maintain a living map of Microsoft security signal: what exists, known ingestion lag, where it lands, what gates it, how long it's kept, and how far you can trust it

  • 5+ years in information technology or security operations, with substantial time spent defending or operating Microsoft environments
  • Excellent tact and diplomacy skills — you can explain Microsoft's limits to an audience that doesn't want to hear about them

We're the software team behind The Light Phone and Mill, so a good share of our work touches devices. This person doesn't need to be a firmware engineer, but they understand how hardware works, where it constrains the software, and how to plan a project that spans both.

The garden3d technology story

Across the collective, they decide which tools and platforms we bet on, how every studio uses agents, and which internal tools are worth turning into products. When someone at garden3d asks "how should we build this?", this person has the answer, or knows who does.

Culture

They model garden3d's values of partnership, curiosity, and accountability. The engineers they lead do the best work of their careers here, because the feedback is honest, the recognition is earned, and the craft rubs off

Â Special Projects

In addition to day to day responsibilities, hereâs an idea of some of the projects this role may spearhead or support in coming years â

  • Making agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer builds, with loops and evals the whole team trusts
  • Setting the shared technical conventions every garden3d studio builds from
  • Landing the kind of flagship engineering engagement that changes what people think we do
  • Hiring the next generation of the engineering team, across every garden3d studio
  • Turning the internal tools and agents we build for ourselves into products
  • Partnering with the Head of Design so our own studio websites are as well engineered as they are designed

Qualifications

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to make a significant impact in a growing, dynamic company. Based on the responsibilities of this role, we think the right candidate has the following experience and skills:

Must have:

  • 12+ years building software, at least three of them leading engineers inside a studio, agency, startup or founder-led company
  • Deep experience engineering complex systems, shipped and run in production: distributed services, data pipelines, multi-platform products
  • A true technology generalist, comfortable across frontend, backend, data, infrastructure and native
  • A strong preference for practical engineering: convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms as a service over bespoke infrastructure
  • All in on agentic development: loop engineering, evals, and agents doing real work in a real codebase
  • Fluency across most of our stack: React, Next.js, Ruby on Rails, Elixir & Phoenix, Sanity, Postgres, Redis. You won't use all of it every week, but you should be able to review any of it
  • Experience as the technical lead in winning work: scoping, estimating and pitching to clients
  • A track record of hiring exceptional engineers, and of people who got measurably better working for them
  • Hands-on. This person can still write the code, not only review it (and will get on the tools when the need arises)

Nice-to-have:

  • A sense of how hardware works: firmware, embedded systems, IoT, and shipping software for physical products
  • Experience in a client services environment (a consultancy, agency or studio)
  • Experience in a Sales Engineer or Solutions Architect role
  • Open source projects they've started or maintained
  • Experience fostering close collaboration between design and engineering teams
  • Experience inside a worker-owned, open-book, or otherwise unusual company
  • A network in the engineering community: the meetups, the conferences, the people worth hiring
  • Interests in design, art, music, food or fashion. We find these people have a well rounded sense of quality

Who you are

The person weâre looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with and appreciates a commitment to a culture of transparency, non-dictatorial leadership styles, and alternative methodologies. Theyâre flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work âsmartâ by carefully managing their workflow and team.

How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, weâll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where weâre going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

Compensation

This is a permanent leadership role. If this individual exceeds expectations in their first four months, we'll shape the permanent role together, with scope and compensation that grow as the studios and their revenue do. After a period of proven success (12 - 24 months), they become eligible to join our worker ownership program.

We start with a 4-month fraction trial contract, paid hourly between $110 - $175 p/hr pending seniority & experience. In the first few weeks of the trial, this individual will propose their own goals to define success in their trial, and present them to our leadership team for approval.

â How we work:

  • Transparency & Ownership:Â We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. Weâre proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.

title: Cloud Network Engineer
description: Headquarters: Remote United States BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio. Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself. The Role The Cloud Network Engineer extends BeyondTrust's on-premises networking fundamentals into AWS cloud networking, with a primary focus on architecting and operating FedRAMP-aligned environments. The successful candidate demonstrates strong technical judgment, operational discipline, and the ability to apply practical solutions to complex hybrid network engineering challenges, while serving as the primary liaison between the Network and Cloud Ops teams. What You’ll Do Operate and maintain BeyondTrust's on-premises and cloud network infrastructure, including routing/switching changes, datacenter resource changes, and routine firewall/security group changes end-to-end across on-prem and cloud environments; escalate complex or security-sensitive changes to the Sr. Engineer/SecOps. Design and implement AWS network architectures, including VPCs, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect, Route 53, and network security controls, aligned with FedRAMP, ISO 27001, and SOX requirements. Lead the CIDR range overlap remediation project by auditing existing on-prem and AWS CIDR allocations, designing a conflict-free addressing plan, and executing remediation/re-IP work with minimal disruption to production traffic. Serve as the primary day-to-day liaison between the Network team and Cloud Ops on network design, shared infrastructure changes, and incident coordination. Mentor Network Administrators and Engineers on cloud networking fundamentals and hybrid connectivity best practices, extending networking expertise into AWS environments. Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code and automation using Terraform, Ansible, Python, contributing reusable modules to the team's shared automation library. Participate in the shared 24x7 on-call rotation, independently resolving Tier-1 and Tier-2 escalations, including cloud connectivity issues. Maintain network diagrams, CIDR/IPAM records, architecture documentation, and SOPs, and provide regular progress updates. Manage vendor relationships for cloud connectivity services, circuit vendors, and network infrastructure procurement and renewals. Work a hybrid or remote schedule depending on geographic proximity to a BeyondTrust office; travel to offices or datacenters as needed (5–10%). What You’ll Bring 3–5 years of total network administration/engineering experience, including 2+ years hands-on AWS cloud networking work with VPC design, Transit Gateway, VPN/Direct Connect, Route 53, network security controls across hybrid environments. Demonstrated proficiency in Administrator/Engineer-level on-premises networking fundamentals. 3-5 hands-on experience with Cisco NX-OS/IOS/IOS-XE, Dell, and Palo Alto equipment. CCNA certification or equivalent hands-on experience Experience implementing and maintaining security controls aligned with industry frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC2, and FedRAMP. Strong documentation and organizational skills — demonstrated ability to produce clear network diagrams, IPAM records, and runbooks that hold up under audit. Strong analytical and cross-team communication skills; comfortable operating as a liaison between technical teams with different priorities. Nice To Have CCNP in progress, or equivalent Network Engineer-level experience. Experience with IPAM tooling such asNetBox, phpIPAM, Infoblox, BlueCat. Experience with Azure networking services and hybrid connectivity. Direct experience supporting a FedRAMP ATO or continuous monitoring (ConMon) process. Formal project management or technical project leadership experience. Proficiency in dynamic routing protocols (EIGRP, BGP) and in identity and access management services including RADIUS, TACACS+, Duo, Okta, and Cisco ISE. Better Together Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected. We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together. About Us BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders. BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners. Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com . #LI-BS1 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/beyondtrust-cloud-network-engineer
